# D09 Factions, Government, Institutions, Legitimacy

## Game Logic Overhaul Alignment Boundary

This document retains its existing proposal status. The formulas, tables, and blueprints are neither implementation facts of Seoul nor approved figures. The Seoul-fact / CK3-reference / product-authority distinctions in the linked chapters below and SP-1.0.0 take precedence, and undecided values are not interpreted as 0 or any arbitrary default. The deep-survey discrepancy totals and clan formulas are not adopted.

[Corresponding Chapters and Confirmed Grounds](/gdd/rules/power-and-institutions/)

Status: Proposed. This distinguishes approved rules, selected policies, unadopted alternatives, and undecided values. It does not mean implementation is complete.

[Design Guide](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index/) · [Situations and Cases](/gdd/system-design/domain-situations/) · [Sheets and Calculations](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/)

## 1. The People Who Run a Faction and the Player's Decisions

The player continues the campaign as a single person with one body. Other characters are NPCs who use the same action contract. Opening the faction screen does not turn the player into another character or grant all of the faction's powers. There is a single world time. Combat has no pause, speed control, or command queue. These combat rules do not determine time adjustment for the campaign or for institutional procedures.

Actors are the current valid officeholder, a proxy within the scope registered in the institution, a candidate, a supporter, and a ratification officer. A faction or city is not the same entity as its head personally, and an institution's property is not the head's personal property. Through their own body and actual authority, the player requests institutional actions, claims eligibility as a candidate, requests support, and submits evidence. Being able to make a request is different from having that request approved.

The head of a faction or city (the President for Life of the Government, a city holder in the Free Cities, the Hierophant of the Arc) takes part in appointments, award proposals, diplomacy, war approval, and succession procedures under its institutions. A higher tier does not open up every action. Which institution a signature is made in, which unit is commanded, and which treasury can be used must each be checked. This distinction applies equally to the player and to NPCs.

## 2. Eligibility and Independent Ledgers

| Ledger | Facts to Check | What It Does Not Grant by Itself |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Character | Identity, survival, and ability to act of the same person | Office, inheritance, command authority |
| Affiliation and citizenship | Which faction, city, or organization one belongs to, and recognition (in the Government, entry in the register) | Declaring war in a faction's name, disposing of public property |
| Office | Institution, seat, jurisdiction, current holder, scope of signature | Ownership of a personal treasury, command of all forces |
| Title and Holding | Target rights and obligations, holder, superior contract, recognition | Immediate on-site use, acquisition of another office |
| Effective control | Who controls the site right now, and occupation or dispute | Lawful possession, cooperation of residents, institutional operation |
| Command | Designated units and the valid scope of command or delegation | Disposing of institution-owned property, incorporating other units |
| Property and access | Ownership, custody, use, and treasury access | Personal ownership of the property accessed |
| Relationships and memory | Trust, kinship, marriage, debts, oaths, and memory of events | Automatic election, inheritance, or appointment to a vacant seat |

Office tier is a classification used for comparison between factions. The same tier is not the same office, and a higher tier does not automatically permit military command, hereditary succession, or diplomacy on behalf of the entire faction. Actual authority comes from within the scope of that office and of separate contracts. A combat commander commands all squads that are included in both the command scope registered in the combat session and the list of assigned squads. One army has one commander (D3); squads carry out immediately issued orders as given, and feasibility limits and the assessment remain the commander's outcome. A faction office and this combat command contract do not replace each other.

A candidate's eligibility, voting rights, and technical qualifications are data separate from a claim to a title of nobility. A relationship record such as spouse, kin, or adopted child does not by itself confer every right or office. Personal trust or support may change with events, but that does not by itself alter an institution's fixed eligibility thresholds or classification criteria. Seoul has no approved values yet for its legitimacy threshold or election scores.

It must be possible to search for a person by name. Even when names are identical or a person has changed their name, identity is confirmed by the permanent ID. Records from past character registration are evidence of past identity issuance and do not replace the current faction's roster of members, candidates, or heads.

## 3. Before the Action, the Action, and After the Action

### 3.1 When Acting in a Valid Office

Before: Distinguish the person, office, institution, target of the action, and the basis for the requested authority. Check whether the holder and the actual actor are the same, whether the office is valid, and whether the request is within the scope of jurisdiction, signature, and command. For actions that require a separate contract or actual on-site access, check that eligibility as well.

Action: A player or NPC requests a signature, command, or operation. Even if a record keeper carries out claim-construction work on the instruction of a qualified head, the record keeper does not thereby become a beneficiary of the target territory.

After: A qualified action leaves behind only the effects of its own contract. Without authority, the requested institutional effect is not established. The existence of a public office does not add ownership or command authority to other ledgers. If there is no faction-specific institutional input, report "institution undecided" and do not apply arbitrary success or free handling.

### 3.2 When a Living Person Loses an Office

Before: A person holds one office and may also have a personal life, movement, other offices, or separate valid contracts.

Action: The grounds for losing that office are confirmed.

After: Only the signatures, commands, and operations that depend on the lost office are suspended. Personal life, movement, and actions under separate valid contracts continue to be judged by their own qualifications. The actions of a living person are not locked wholesale. That vacancy alone does not cause inheritance, transfer of rights, appointment of a proxy, or absorption of authority into another seat. The institution's treasury does not become personal property. If another contract expires under its own conditions, the authority under that contract also ends, but the vacancy itself does not expire a separate contract.

### 3.3 When the Head Dies

Before: The head's office, title, property, and contracts exist as separate items.

Action: The grounds for death are confirmed. The deceased cannot begin new personal actions, and the office becomes vacant.

After: The institution and the faction do not automatically dissolve merely because the head has died. The institution's property is not converted into the head's personal estate. For each item, the succession institution lookup, candidate eligibility check, election, nomination, examination, or hereditary procedure, ratification, transfer of rights, handover and takeover, and dispute records proceed only when each has its own grounds. Defeated candidates are not deleted, and remaining claims are recorded according to the institution. If there is no eligible person or procedure, the matter remains a vacancy or succession dispute, and no anonymous head is created to treat it as a success.

Succession of the body, succession of the head of a faction or institution, and succession of individual titles and property are separate events. A new body does not inherit the previous body's authority, skills, or friends. That said, the new body and the new head need not necessarily be different people. If the office's institution, candidate check, procedure, and ratification have independently chosen the same person, the same person may hold it. The fact that the body changed is not itself grounds for that selection or for inheritance. Even if the body changes because of permanent detention, the detained person is still alive, so inheritance upon death is not opened.

### 3.4 Proxy for a Vacancy and the Survival of the Organization

Before: The office is vacant; check whether there is a proxy registered in the institution and a defined scope.

Action: The registered proxy requests an action within the scope.

After: Only the registered scope may be exercised. A proxy does not substitute for electing a head or for permanently transferring the office. A simple delegation contract is also not an automatic proxy appointment. Proxy authority is not granted to unregistered persons or to requests outside the scope.

The latest choice is to let the identity and obligations of a landless organization with living members persist until they are lawfully resolved. The death of its leader and the loss of its territory alone do not erase an organization. Who the surviving representative, treasury custodian, and dissolution authority are requires separate input, and no one is appointed here.

## 4. Starting Succession Methods and Faction Inputs Still Needed

The methods below are the starting settings recorded in the v3 world setting (01-core sections 7-8, chapter 04 sections 3.1-3.2, chapter 05 sections 2.1-2.2, chapter 06 sections 3.3-3.4). They carry over those chapters' provisional items; this document decides nothing new. Do not read a method's name as an actual candidate roster or a finished election algorithm.

| Faction and seat | Method in the current setting | Detailed inputs needed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Government · President for Life | Acclamation. The fourteen Members of the National Assembly stamp under the name of one of their own, and it holds only when all fourteen stamps are in. It opens the day after the President dies; the oldest Member presides and signs as acting President meanwhile | Candidate eligibility, reconvening when the stamps are not all in, the acting President's signing scope, how the President's house hands down its seat |
| Government · Member of the National Assembly (one district, one duchy) | Handed-down seat. When a Member dies or steps down, the head of the house names a successor, who becomes the candidate at the next election. Until the election the successor uses the district office's seal as acting Member | Record of the house head's naming, the election and the register entry, the acting Member's seal scope |
| Free Cities · city holder (Ferry Keeper, Market Master, Works Master, Edge Warden, Wind Keeper) | The masters' meeting of the seal houses sets a holder for life by name-worth. There are no votes, and what is counted differs city by city | Each city's name-worth yardstick, candidate eligibility, handling when name-worth is within 5, each city's conditions for stepping down |
| Yangcheon · Depot Master, Gwanak · Duke | The holder always comes from one house. Yangcheon has only one seal house; in Gwanak the masters' meeting has bound the seal, so the holder is chosen by name-worth inside the ducal house | Name-worth of the candidates inside one house, the law of binding the seal and the resentment it draws |
| The Free Cities as a whole | No head. There are only contract meetings called as needed and their Host, and a contract meeting chooses no city's holder | The scope the Host holds |
| Arc · Hierophant | How the Hierophant after Go Ye-jin is chosen is not decided. Default (provisional): a name the Hierophant has spoken while alive comes first; otherwise the Seat of the Four Near Houses chooses among the four Heads and their blood, and if Go Ye-jin has blood heirs they come first | Owner decision, how a spoken name is recorded |
| Arc · Head of the Near House (one district) | Handed down by blood inside the Near House. If no one has been named, the house gathers and chooses, and the next Head must have at least two parts. Disputes are heard at the Seat of the Four Near Houses and ended by the Hierophant's word. The Hierophant names and removes Near Houses | Checking the part count, the procedure by which a removed Near House gives up its district |

What happens when the stamps of an acclamation never all come in, the scope of an acting Member and an acting President, and how the Hierophant after Go Ye-jin is chosen are confirmed open questions. Do not arbitrarily merge the three factions' systems into one just because the methods differ.

## 5. Failure, Interruption, and Information

Unqualified requests, signatures beyond the scope of authority, and acting coverage without registration do not generate the corresponding authority. A vacancy with no candidate or with an undecided procedure is not displayed as a completed succession. Tie-breaking has not yet been approved either, so neither first-come-first-served nor arbitrary drawing is to be added. However, this undecided state is not a rule permanently forbidding succession in every faction. Once a concrete system is approved, it must be judged by that procedure.

Canceling a task in the world, or a character dying, does not undo progress already completed or resources already consumed. Remaining execution and qualifications going forward are handled by the relevant action contract. The fact that an institution keeps ownership of its treasury does not mean the treasury balance is fixed in every event. Lawful institutional spending and handovers are judged by their respective asset contracts. Results already applied are not applied again to duplicate effects or consumption, and approved rule versions are not changed silently.

The information a player needs includes the post name, institution, holder, and vacancy; the basis and scope of authority for an action; the registered scope of acting coverage; the distinction between an undecided system and a candidate's lack of qualification; and the distinction between recognition, effective control, and the right to a title. This is a proposal for information display and is distinct from approval to omnisciently reveal every treasury balance, secret ballot, or other people's memories. The scope of disclosure must define the viewing rights of institutions and actors.

## 6. Examples of Meaningful Judgments

### Example A: One Person Holds Two Posts

Before: A character holds a valid convoy command contract separate from their institution's record-keeping post. Action: They lose only the record-keeping post. After: They can no longer sign ratifications based on that post, but convoy command is judged by the target and qualifications of the separate contract. Ratification authority does not shift to another post, and personal movement is not halted wholesale because of the vacancy. If the convoy contract has also expired, that is the result of a separate expiry.

### Example B: A Leader's Death and the Same Person's Lawful Election

Before: A leader dies, and the character chosen for the new body is also a successor candidate. Action: Separately from the body transfer, they go through the faction's candidate screening, election, and ratification procedures. After: If the procedure independently selects that person, the new body and the leader may be the same person. If there is no system or candidate, the post remains vacant or disputed. A body transfer alone does not pass on the treasury, titles, technology, or friends.

### Example C: Acting Coverage and Institutional Spending

Before: The leader's post is vacant, and the institution has a registered deputy and a registered scope of duties. Action: The deputy requests a signature on that duty. After: Whether it falls within scope is judged, and separate treasury-access and spending authority is also checked. Signing-deputy qualification alone does not allow the deputy to dispose of the entire treasury personally. If an approved institutional expenditure exists, the balance may change, but the owning entity does not become the deputy personally.

### Example D: Different Bases for Occupation, Arrival, and War Termination

Before: A unit has occupied the site, and another unit is on the move. Action: The arriving unit's eligibility to participate is judged after its actual arrival. Any unit that actually arrives at an ongoing battle is permitted to join as reinforcement. After: Occupation is a record of effective control, not the acquisition of a post or the recognition of a right. A war applies a valid casus belli, goal-limited war score in the range ±100, and custom negotiation. An attacker supporting another person's claim is distinguished from the rights beneficiary, and the continued validity of the casus belli is checked even before forced termination. Title and right transfers after termination are judged on the basis of D10, occupation and war records and organizational survival on D16, and agreements and settlement on D17. No effect occurs automatically from occupation or body transfer alone.

## 7. Ownership Boundaries with Other Domains

| Domain | Judgments Covered | What It Provides to D09 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| D01·D02 | Identity, character state, and event records | Whether it is the same person, survival, permanent ID, and applied results |
| D03 | Common action and command contract | Eligibility to perform and basis of authority, checked separately from the office |
| D07 | Personal relationships, memory, loyalty, and evaluation | Distinguishing shifting support and field judgment/evaluation from fixed institutional eligibility |
| D08 | Kinship, marriage, adoption, and family law | Distinguishing records from legal candidate eligibility |
| D10 | Titles, claims, and ratification | Rights and beneficiaries distinguished from the office |
| D11 | Delegation and signature contracts, and revocation | Validity and scope of that contract alone |
| D12 | Body succession and detention/return | Body selection, separate from succession to the leader |
| D13 | Property, treasury, inheritance, and handover | Institutional ownership versus personal ownership and actual expenditure |
| D15 | Combat, command, squads, and reinforcements | Command of every squad in the intersection of the combat session's registered command scope and the attached roster; immediate orders carried out by the squads (D3); reinforcements only after they actually arrive during the battle |
| D16 | Diplomacy, casus belli, war, siege, prisoners, occupation, and organizational survival and dissolution | Valid casus belli and objective-limited termination, the distinction between control and recognition, and the organizational life cycle |
| D17 | Negotiation, trade, peace, and contracts | Basis for user-defined negotiation, agreement, and settlement; linked to D16 war and D10 rights handling |
| D18 | World clock, event order, and saving | Same rule version and no duplicate application |

This table divides design responsibilities; it is not a record appointing execution code or an operational custodian.

## 8. Structures Confirmed in the Two Source Games and Limits of Comparison

### Crusader Kings III

In the preserved 1.20.0.3 / build 25652598 materials, feudal elections handle the voter set, candidate filter, vote weight, and candidate score separately. This can be used for comparisons that distinguish one person's candidate eligibility from their votes. The overall tally and final tie resolution are not confirmed, and quorum and ties are investigated but unresolved. Do not read an unknown rule as ‘none’ or as 0.

Bureaucratic appointments involve government access, candidate tiers, score order, and the context of handling office transfers, and the restrictions on holding a council seat together with other offices are conditional. They cannot be carried over as a concurrent-office ban applying to all of Seoul. In handling finance-related vacancies, there are commands that, under conditions such as having no successor councillor, add treasury funds to a superior and destroy the title. Explicit deduction from the previous treasury and final preservation of assets are not proven. Therefore, do not say that ‘the treasury is transferred completely,’ or that it equals the continued existence of a Seoul institutional treasury.

A regency is a context in which power is shared with an existing ruler, and its validity and actual capability conditions differ. It is not the same as Seoul's acting role, which fills in for an empty office. In tests, the annotations and the actual operands differ, so the actual values and units must be distinguished. Legitimacy uses classification thresholds multiplied by coefficients according to tier and era, but raw rounding and initialization are not proven. This material does not adopt any Seoul legitimacy formula or threshold value. General character generation or test-tube generation is likewise not evidence for ‘generating an unknown leader for every election vacancy.’

### Norland

In the preserved documents of the official wiki and official patches, ruler-only actions, lord candidate eligibility, politician selection, and specific relationship updates on accession and on a suzerain's death each have different handling. The general ruler eligibility table does not fully explain candidate priority, ties, or the default successor. Concurrent holding of politician and successor roles is also directional and conditional, so it must not be turned into a universal permission or ban on holding multiple offices.

The politics-related threshold was 20 in main 50–53, then restored to 40 in beta 55 / main 54–56, and Actions revision 1318 also records 40. Do not use the historical 20 as a current invariant. The knowledge-based politician selection of beta 43 was changed to persuasion-based selection in main 46–48. The strict ‘greater than 6’ persuasion requirement does not include being equal to 6, but candidate ties and the actual selection order are unresolved. These values are not Seoul eligibility values.

Noble exhaustion, a suzerain's death, and an existing lord's resettlement of ruins are each documented facts within their own contexts. They do not prove a general rule that a new leader is generated for every vacancy. The treasury modifications concerning confiscated funds and the ruler's ring (a source-game item) likewise do not fully prove the treasury custodian, spending authority, or survival during a vacancy. The capacity for free-lord titles is not the geometry of Seoul's territory or the identity of an institutional office. Voting, quorum, tests, scope of acting authority, legitimacy figures, and the order of sequential processing remain within the limits of the preserved materials even in the source games.

The structures of the two source games serve as a basis for comparing Seoul's institutions. They are limited to what was confirmed in the preserved documents and are not observations of the game running. Some materials lack a confirmed correspondence between document version and historical build, so actual behavior in that build cannot be established.

## 9. Concrete Alternatives to Decide

The following are proposals before adoption. Do not treat any alternative as approving numbers, ratifiers, or durations.

| Item | Consumer Use and Ideal | Current Gap and Reason | Concrete Alternatives | QA Questions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Candidacy, election, quorum, ties, and ratification by faction and city | The institutional officer confirms an eligible person as a leader with a documented basis | Only the name of the starting method exists, and election details are undecided | For the elective type, confirm by a registered electoral roll and ratification, or confirm by council agreement; for a tie, confirm after a revote or arbitration by the ratifying body | Is it ensured that no leader without a basis arises from ties, candidate exhaustion, or missing votes? |
| Heredity and Family Law | Check lineage and eligibility for public office separately | Marriage, adoption, order of eligible children, and exceptions are undecided by faction | Follow the order of eligible lineage, but require ratification, or independent ratification after a house nomination | Even if the new body and the leader are the same, is there an independent basis? Is nothing inherited by a relationship notation alone? |
| Seats that decide together (acclamation, masters' meeting, Seat of the Four Near Houses) | Connect the roles of multiple bodies consistently | The order of handling when the stamps are not all in, when name-worth is close, and when a Near House dispute arises is undecided | Confirm a head only through the procedure of the set seat; on failure keep the vacancy, or let a registered acting holder take only the signing scope | Does a vacancy in one seat avoid automatically absorbing the authority of another seat? |
| Acting Role and Regency | Distinguish vacancy duties from assisting the existing leader | Registering party, scope changes, revocation, and duration are undecided | Maintain only the pre-registered scope, or change the scope by a separate, lawful institutional decision | Does it block unregistered persons and out-of-scope requests? |
| Legitimacy | Shows the grounds for ratification, cooperation, and disputes | Facts, figures, and thresholds to record are undecided | Display only event records of ratifications and disputes, or add separately approved figures and fixed classifications | Does a change in personal support leave the fixed thresholds themselves unchanged? |
| Title, Ratification, and War Effects | Links D10's judgment of rights and beneficiaries, D16's casus belli and war termination, and D17's negotiation and settlement | Actual titles, territories, superior contracts, ratifying bodies, and detailed termination effects are undecided | Confirm the right through an institution's recognition document, or ratify separately after the parties agree | Does it distinguish the attacker from the beneficiary and terminate only the casus belli that remains valid? |
| Landless Organization | Handle the remaining identities and obligations lawfully | A direction for what remains has been chosen, but the representative, custodian, and dissolution procedure are undecided | Keep the existing valid representative, or designate a limited custodian through a lawful institutional procedure | Does it avoid deleting the organization merely because of death or loss of territory, and avoid creating an unauthorized representative? |
| Organization Values and Information Disclosure | Designs support judgments and record access | The value list is a proposal, and access rights are undecided | Show only public ratifications and vacancies, or disclose a detailed ledger by authority level; distinguish value changes as event records versus separate policy amendments | Are name search, ID identity, and the boundary of non-public information maintained? |
| Health and Derived Abilities as Office Qualifications | The qualification proposer links personal calculations to institutional qualifications | No approval of the original Basic or of the relevant calculations | Use only independent institutional qualifications without health figures, or read separate personal results after the original and calculations are approved | Does it avoid replacing the original with public excerpts or Lite, and avoid inserting unapproved scores? |

There are no approved numbers for legitimacy scores, exam scores, quorums, acting periods, or new costs. Whether health or derived abilities will be used as office qualifications, and if so by what criteria candidates will be distinguished, has not yet been decided.

# D09 세력·정부·기관·정통성

## 게임 로직 개편 정합 경계

이 문서는 기존 제안 상태를 유지한다. 산식·표·청사진은 서울의 구현 사실이나 승인 수치가 아니다. 아래 연결된 장의 서울 사실/CK3 참조/제품 권한 구분과 SP-1.0.0이 우선하며 미정 값을 0 또는 임의 기본값으로 해석하지 않는다. 깊이조사의 불일치 총계·씨족 산식은 채택하지 않는다.

[대응 장과 확인된 근거](/gdd/rules/power-and-institutions/)

상태: 제안. 승인된 규칙, 선택된 정책, 미채택 대안과 미정 수치를 구분한다. 구현 완료를 뜻하지 않는다.

[설계 길잡이](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index/) · [상황과 사례](/gdd/system-design/domain-situations/) · [시트와 계산](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/)

## 1. 세력을 움직이는 사람과 플레이어의 결정

플레이어는 하나의 몸인 한 사람으로 캠페인을 이어 간다. 다른 인물도 동일한 행동 계약을 사용하는 NPC다. 세력 화면을 열었다고 다른 인물이 되거나 세력의 모든 권한을 얻지 않는다. 세계 시간은 하나다. 전투에는 일시정지·속도 조절·명령 큐가 없다. 이 전투 규칙으로 캠페인이나 기관 절차의 시간 조절을 정하지 않는다.

행위자는 지금 유효한 직위 보유자, 제도에 등록된 범위의 대행자, 후보, 지지자, 인준 담당자다. 세력과 도시는 수장 개인과 같은 존재가 아니며 기관의 재산도 수장 개인의 재산이 아니다. 플레이어는 자신의 몸과 실제 권한을 통해 기관 행동을 요청하고, 후보로 자격을 주장하며, 지지를 요청하거나 근거를 제출한다. 요청할 수 있다는 것과 그 요청이 승인된다는 것은 다르다.

세력이나 도시의 수장(정부의 종신 대통령, 자유도시들의 도시 우두머리, 아크의 교주)은 그 제도에 따른 임명·수여 제안·외교·전쟁 승인·후계 절차에 참여한다. 티어가 높다는 이유로 모든 행동이 열리지 않는다. 어느 기관에서 어떤 서명을 하는지, 어느 부대를 지휘하는지, 어떤 금고를 사용할 수 있는지 각각 확인해야 한다. 플레이어와 NPC에 이 구분이 똑같이 적용된다.

## 2. 자격과 서로 독립된 장부

| 장부 | 확인할 사실 | 그것만으로 얻지 못하는 것 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 인물 | 동일 인물의 신원, 생존, 행동 가능 상태 | 직위·상속·지휘권 |
| 소속·시민 자격 | 어느 세력·도시·조직의 구성원인지와 인정(정부는 장부 등재) | 세력 이름의 선전포고·공공 재산 처분 |
| 직위 | 기관, 자리, 관할, 현재 보유자, 서명 범위 | 개인 금고 소유·모든 병력 지휘 |
| 작위·작위 영역 | 대상 권리와 의무, 보유자, 상위 계약, 인정 | 현장의 즉시 사용·다른 직위 취득 |
| 실효 지배 | 지금 현장에서 통제하는 사람과 점령·분쟁 | 합법 보유·주민 협조·기관 운영 |
| 지휘 | 지정 부대와 유효한 지휘·위임 범위 | 기관 소유 재산 처분·타 부대 편입 |
| 재산·접근 | 소유, 보관, 사용, 금고 접근 | 접근한 재산의 개인 소유 |
| 관계·기억 | 신뢰, 친족, 혼인, 빚, 맹세와 사건 기억 | 자동 선출·상속·빈자리 임명 |

직위 티어는 세력 사이에서 비교하는 분류다. 같은 티어도 같은 직위가 아니며 높은 티어가 군사 지휘·세습·세력 전체 외교를 자동 허용하지 않는다. 실제 권한은 그 직위와 별도 계약의 범위에서 온다. 전투 지휘관은 전투 세션에 등록된 지휘 범위와 배속 분대 목록에 모두 포함되는 모든 분대를 지휘한다. 군대 하나에는 지휘관 하나가 있고(D3), 즉시 하달된 명령은 분대가 그대로 수행하며 수행 가능성의 한계와 평가는 지휘관의 결과로 남는다. 세력의 직위와 이 전투 지휘 계약은 서로를 대체하지 않는다.

후보의 자격, 투표권, 기술 자격은 작위 주장과 다른 자료다. 배우자·친족·양자라는 관계 기록만으로 모든 권리나 직위를 받지 않는다. 개인적 신뢰나 지지는 사건에 따라 변할 수 있으나, 그것이 제도의 고정 자격 문턱이나 분류 기준을 저절로 바꾸지는 않는다. 서울의 정통성 문턱값이나 선출 점수는 아직 승인된 값이 없다.

이름으로 사람을 검색할 수 있어야 한다. 이름이 같거나 개명한 경우에도 동일성은 영구 ID로 확인한다. 과거 인물 등록 자료는 과거 신원 발급의 증거이며 현재 세력의 구성원·후보·수장 명부를 대신하지 않는다.

## 3. 행동 전·행동·행동 후

### 3.1 유효한 직위로 행동할 때

전: 인물, 직위, 기관, 행동 대상, 요청한 권한 근거를 구별한다. 보유자와 실제 행위자가 같은지, 직위가 유효한지, 요청이 관할·서명·지휘 범위 안인지 확인한다. 별도 계약이나 실제 현장 접근이 필요한 행동은 그 자격도 확인한다.

행동: 플레이어 또는 NPC가 서명·지휘·운영을 요청한다. 기록 담당자가 자격 있는 수장의 지시에 따라 주장 구성 작업을 하더라도 기록 담당자가 대상 영토의 수혜자가 되는 것은 아니다.

후: 적격한 행동은 자기 계약의 효과만 남긴다. 권한이 없으면 요청한 기관 효과는 성립하지 않는다. 공직의 존재는 다른 장부에 소유권이나 지휘권을 덧붙이지 않는다. 세력별 제도 입력이 없으면 ‘제도 미정’으로 알리고 임의의 성공이나 무료 처리를 하지 않는다.

### 3.2 살아 있는 사람이 직위를 잃을 때

전: 인물이 직위 하나를 보유하고, 개인 생활·이동·다른 직위 또는 별도 유효 계약을 가지고 있을 수 있다.

행동: 그 직위의 상실 근거가 확정된다.

후: 상실한 직위에 의존하는 서명·지휘·운영만 중단된다. 개인 생활과 이동, 별도 유효 계약의 행동은 각자의 자격으로 계속 판단한다. 살아 있는 사람의 모든 행동을 일괄 잠그지 않는다. 그 공석만으로 상속·권리 이전·대행 임명·다른 자리로의 권한 흡수가 일어나지 않는다. 기관 금고는 개인 재산이 되지 않는다. 다른 계약이 자체 조건으로 만료되면 그 계약에 따른 권한도 끝나지만, 공석 자체가 별도 계약을 만료시킨 것은 아니다.

### 3.3 수장이 죽었을 때

전: 수장의 직위·작위·재산·계약은 서로 다른 항목으로 존재한다.

행동: 사망 근거가 확정된다. 사망한 사람은 새로운 개인 행동을 시작하지 못하고 직위는 공석이 된다.

후: 기관과 세력은 수장의 죽음만으로 자동 소멸하지 않는다. 기관의 재산을 수장의 개인 유산으로 바꾸지 않는다. 각 항목의 후계 제도 조회, 후보 자격 검사, 선거·지명·시험·세습 절차, 인준, 권리 이전, 인도·인수, 분쟁 기록은 각각의 근거가 있어야 진행한다. 탈락한 후보를 삭제하지 않고 남은 주장은 제도에 따라 기록한다. 적격자나 절차가 없으면 공석·승계 분쟁으로 남으며 무명 수장을 만들어 성공 처리하지 않는다.

몸의 계승, 세력·기관 수장 계승, 개별 작위·재산 계승은 별도 사건이다. 새 몸은 이전 몸의 권한·기술·친구를 복사받지 않는다. 그렇다고 새 몸과 새 수장이 반드시 다른 사람이어야 하는 것은 아니다. 직위의 제도·후보 검사·절차·인준이 독립적으로 같은 사람을 선택했다면 같은 사람이 맡을 수 있다. 몸이 바뀐 사실 자체는 그 선택이나 상속의 근거가 아니다. 영구 구금으로 몸이 바뀌어도 구금된 사람은 살아 있으므로 사망 상속을 열지 않는다.

### 3.4 공석의 대행과 조직의 잔존

전: 직위가 공석이며 제도에 등록된 대행 인물과 범위가 있는지 확인한다.

행동: 등록된 대행자가 범위 안의 행동을 요청한다.

후: 등록된 범위만 행사할 수 있다. 대행이 수장 선출이나 직위의 영구 이전을 대신하지 않는다. 단순 위임 계약도 자동 대행 임명은 아니다. 등록되지 않은 사람이나 범위 밖의 요청에 대행 권한을 부여하지 않는다.

최신 선택은 살아 있는 구성원이 있는 무영토 조직의 신원과 의무를 적법한 해결 전까지 잔존시키는 방향이다. 수장 사망과 영토 상실만으로 조직을 지우지 않는다. 구체적인 잔존 대표·금고 보관자·해산 권한이 누구인지는 별도 입력이 필요하며 여기서 사람을 임명하지 않는다.

## 4. 시작 계승 방식과 아직 필요한 세력 입력

아래 방식은 v3 세계 설정(01-core 7~8절, 04장 3.1~3.2절, 05장 2.1~2.2절, 06장 3.3~3.4절)에 적힌 시작 설정이다. 그 장들의 잠정 항목을 옮긴 것이며 이 문서가 새로 정한 것은 없다. 방식의 이름을 실제 후보 명부나 완성된 선출 알고리즘으로 읽지 않는다.

| 세력·자리 | 지금 세계관의 방식 | 상세 기획에서 필요한 입력 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 정부 · 종신 대통령 | 추대. 국회의원 열넷이 국회의원 가운데 한 사람의 이름 아래 도장을 찍고, 열네 도장이 다 모여야 이루어진다. 대통령이 죽은 다음 날 열리고, 가장 나이 많은 국회의원이 주재하며 그동안 권한대행으로 결재한다 | 후보 자격, 도장이 다 모이지 않을 때의 재소집, 권한대행의 결재 범위, 대통령 집안의 의석 물림 |
| 정부 · 국회의원(구 하나, 공작령 하나) | 대물림 의석. 국회의원이 죽거나 물러나면 그 집안 세대주가 후계를 지명하고, 후계가 다음 선거의 후보가 된다. 선거 전까지 후계는 의원 직무대리로 구청의 도장을 쓴다 | 세대주 지명의 기록, 선거와 장부 등재, 직무대리의 도장 범위 |
| 자유도시들 · 도시 우두머리(나루지기, 장주, 공장장, 경계장, 바람지기) | 도장 집안 대주들의 대주회가 이름값으로 종신 우두머리를 정한다. 표가 없고, 무엇을 세느냐는 도시마다 다르다 | 도시별 이름값 잣대, 후보 자격, 이름값이 5 안쪽으로 붙을 때의 처리, 도시별 물러남 조건 |
| 양천 · 기지장, 관악 · 공작 | 우두머리가 늘 한 집안에서 나온다. 양천은 도장 집안이 하나뿐이고, 관악은 대주회가 도장을 묶어 공작 집안 안에서 이름값으로 정한다 | 한 집안 안 후보들의 이름값, 도장 묶기의 법과 그것이 사는 원성 |
| 자유도시들 전체 | 수장이 없다. 그때그때 여는 계약회와 자리주인뿐이며, 계약회는 어느 도시의 우두머리도 정하지 않는다 | 자리주인이 맡는 범위 |
| 아크 · 교주 | 고예진 다음을 어떻게 정할지는 정해지지 않았다. 기본값(잠정): 교주가 살아 있을 때 말해 둔 이름이 앞서고, 없으면 네 곁집 자리가 곁집장 넷과 그 핏줄 가운데서 고르며, 고예진에게 핏줄이 생기면 그 핏줄이 먼저다 | 소유자 결정, 말해 둔 이름의 기록 방식 |
| 아크 · 곁집장(구 하나) | 곁집 안에서 피를 따라 대물린다. 말해 둔 사람이 없으면 곁집 집안이 모여 고르고, 다음 곁집장은 부위가 둘 이상이어야 한다. 다툼은 네 곁집 자리에서 듣고 교주의 말로 끝낸다. 교주가 곁집을 정하고 물린다 | 부위 수 확인, 물린 곁집이 구를 내놓는 절차 |

추대에서 도장이 끝내 다 모이지 않을 때의 처리, 국회의원 직무대리와 대통령 권한대행의 범위, 고예진 다음 교주의 결정 방식은 확정 질문이다. 방식이 다르다는 이유로 세 세력의 제도를 임의로 하나로 통일하지 않는다.

## 5. 실패·중단·정보

자격 없는 요청, 권한 범위를 넘는 서명, 등록 없는 대행은 해당 권한을 발생시키지 않는다. 후보가 없거나 절차가 미정인 공석을 완성된 승계로 표시하지 않는다. 동점 처리도 아직 승인되지 않았으므로 선착순이나 임의 추첨을 붙이지 않는다. 다만 이 미정은 모든 세력에 영구적으로 승계를 금지하는 규칙이 아니다. 구체적 제도가 승인되면 그 절차로 판단해야 한다.

세계에서 작업을 취소하거나 인물이 죽었다고 이미 완료한 진척과 소비를 없던 일로 하지 않는다. 앞으로 남은 수행과 자격은 해당 행동 계약에서 처리한다. 기관 금고의 소유가 유지된다는 사실은 금고 잔고가 모든 사건에서 고정된다는 뜻이 아니다. 적법한 기관 지출과 인도는 각각의 자산 계약으로 판단한다. 이미 적용된 결과를 다시 적용해 효과나 소비를 중복시키지 않으며 승인된 규칙 판본을 조용히 바꾸지 않는다.

플레이어에게 필요한 정보는 직위명·기관·보유자·공석, 행동의 권한 근거와 범위, 등록된 대행 범위, 제도 미정과 후보 자격 부족의 구분, 인정·실효 지배·작위 권리의 구분이다. 이는 정보 표시 제안이며 모든 금고 잔액·비공개 표·타인의 기억을 전지적으로 공개하는 승인과는 다르다. 공개 범위는 기관·행위자의 열람권을 정해야 한다.

## 6. 의미 있는 판단 예시

### 예시 A: 같은 사람이 두 직위를 가진 경우

전: 한 인물이 기관의 기록 직위와 별도로 유효한 호송 지휘 계약을 가진다. 행동: 기록 직위만 잃는다. 후: 그 직위를 근거로 한 인준 서명은 못 하지만 호송 지휘는 별도 계약의 대상과 자격으로 판단한다. 다른 직위로 인준권이 옮겨 가지 않고 개인 이동도 공석 때문에 일괄 중단되지 않는다. 호송 계약까지 만료된 경우는 별도 만료의 결과다.

### 예시 B: 수장 사망과 같은 사람의 합법적 선출

전: 수장이 죽고 새 몸으로 선택된 인물이 후계 후보이기도 하다. 행동: 몸 전환과 별도로 세력의 후보 검사·선출·인준 절차를 밟는다. 후: 절차가 독립적으로 그 사람을 선택하면 새 몸과 수장이 같은 사람일 수 있다. 제도나 후보가 없으면 공석·분쟁으로 남는다. 몸 전환만으로 금고·작위·기술·친구가 전달되지는 않는다.

### 예시 C: 대행과 기관 지출

전: 수장은 공석이고 기관에는 등록된 대행과 등록된 업무 범위가 있다. 행동: 대행자가 그 업무의 서명을 요청한다. 후: 범위 안인지 판단하며 별도 금고 접근·지출 권한도 확인한다. 서명 대행 자격만으로 금고 전체를 개인적으로 처분하지 못한다. 승인된 기관 지출이 있으면 잔고가 변할 수 있지만 소유 주체를 대행 개인으로 바꾸지는 않는다.

### 예시 D: 점령, 도착, 전쟁 종료의 다른 근거

전: 부대가 현장을 점령했고 다른 부대가 이동 중이다. 행동: 도착한 부대는 실제 도착 뒤 참여 자격을 판단한다. 진행 중인 전투에 실제 도착한 어느 부대든 증원 참여가 허용된다. 후: 점령은 실효 지배 기록이지 직위 취득이나 권리 인정이 아니다. 전쟁에는 유효한 명분과 목표 한정 전쟁점수 범위 ±100, 사용자 정의 협상이 적용된다. 다른 사람의 주장을 지원하는 공격자와 권리 수혜자는 구별하며 강제 종결 전에도 명분의 계속 유효성을 확인한다. 종결 뒤의 작위·권리 이전은 D10, 점령·전쟁 기록과 조직 잔존은 D16, 합의와 정산은 D17의 근거로 각각 판단한다. 어느 효과도 점령이나 몸 전환만으로 자동 발생하지 않는다.

| D03 | 공통 행동·명령 계약 | 직위와 별도로 검사하는 수행 자격·권한 근거 |
| D07 | 개인 관계·기억·충성·평가 | 변하는 지지와 현장 판단·평가, 고정 제도 자격과의 구분 |
| D08 | 친족·혼인·양자와 가족법 | 기록과 법적 후보 자격의 구분 |
| D10 | 작위·주장·인준 | 직위와 구별된 권리·수혜자 |
| D11 | 위임·서명 계약과 회수 | 해당 계약만의 유효성과 범위 |
| D12 | 몸 계승과 구금·복귀 | 수장 계승과 별도인 몸 선택 |
| D13 | 재산·금고·상속·인도 | 기관 소유와 개인 소유·실제 지출 |
| D15 | 전투·지휘·분대·증원 | 전투 세션 등록 지휘 범위와 배속 목록의 교집합인 모든 분대 지휘, 즉시 명령과 분대의 수행(D3), 진행 중 실제 도착 뒤 증원 |
| D16 | 외교·명분·전쟁·공성·포로·점령·조직 잔존과 해산 | 유효한 명분과 목표 한정 종결, 통제와 인정의 구분, 조직 생명주기 |
| D17 | 협상·거래·강화·계약 | 사용자 정의 협상과 합의·정산의 근거; D16 전쟁과 D10 권리 처리에 연결 |
| D18 | 세계 시계·사건 순서·저장 | 같은 규칙 판본·중복 적용 금지 |

이 표는 설계상 책임 구분이며 실행 코드나 운영 보관자를 임명한 기록이 아니다.

## 8. 두 원작에서 확인한 구조와 비교 한계

### Crusader Kings III

보존된 1.20.0.3 / build 25652598 자료에서 봉건선거는 선거인 집합·후보 필터·표의 힘·후보 점수를 따로 다룬다. 한 사람의 후보 적격과 득표를 구별하는 비교에 쓸 수 있다. 전체 집계나 최종 동수 해결은 확인되지 않았고 정족수·동점은 조사된 미해결이다. 모르는 규칙을 ‘없음’이나 0으로 읽지 않는다.

관료 임명에는 정부 접근·후보 티어·점수 순서와 직위 이전 처리의 문맥이 있으며, 평의회와 다른 직위의 겸임 제한은 조건별이다. 서울 전체에 적용할 겸직 금지로 옮길 수 없다. 재무 관련 공석 처리에서는 후임 평의원이 없는 등 조건 아래 상급자에게 금고 자금을 더하고 작위를 파괴하는 명령이 보인다. 이전 금고의 명시적 차감과 최종 자산 보존은 입증되지 않았다. 따라서 ‘금고를 완전히 이전한다’거나 서울 기관 금고의 존속과 같다고 말하지 않는다.

섭정은 기존 군주와 권력을 공유하는 문맥이며 유효성과 실제 능력 조건이 다르다. 빈 직위를 대신 채우는 서울 대행과 동일하지 않다. 시험에서는 주석과 실행 피연산자가 달라 실제 값과 단위를 구별해야 한다. 정통성은 티어와 시대에 따라 계수가 곱해지는 분류 문턱을 사용하지만 원시 반올림과 초기화는 입증되지 않았다. 서울의 정통성 식이나 문턱값을 이 자료에서 채택하지 않는다. 일반 인물 생성이나 시험관 생성도 ‘선거 공석마다 무명 수장 생성’의 증거가 아니다.

### Norland

공식 위키와 공식 패치의 보존 문서에서는 통치자 전용 행동, 영주 후보 자격, 정치인 선택, 즉위 및 종주 사망에 따른 특정 관계 갱신이 서로 다른 처리를 가진다. 일반 통치자 자격표가 후보 우선순위·동점·기본 후계자를 완전히 설명하지는 않는다. 정치인과 후계자 겸임도 방향별 조건이므로 보편적 겸직 허용이나 금지로 만들지 않는다.

정치 관련 문턱은 main 50–53의 20 이후 beta 55 / main 54–56에서 40으로 복원됐고 Actions 개정 1318도 40을 기록한다. 역사적 20을 현재 불변값으로 쓰지 않는다. beta 43의 지식 기반 정치인 선택은 main 46–48의 설득 기반 선택으로 바뀌었다. 설득 자격의 엄격한 ‘6보다 큼’은 6과 같음을 포함하지 않지만 후보 동점과 실제 선택 순서는 미해결이다. 이 값은 서울 자격값이 아니다.

귀족 소진·종주 사망·기존 영주의 폐허 재정착은 각각 자기 문맥의 문서 사실이다. 공석마다 새 수장을 생성한다는 일반 규칙을 증명하지 않는다. 몰수금과 통치자의 반지(원작 물품)에 관한 금고 수정도 금고 보관자·지출권·공석 중 생존을 완전히 입증하지 않는다. 자유 영주 작위 수용량은 서울 영토의 기하나 기관 직위의 동일성이 아니다. 투표·정족수·시험·대행 범위·정통성 수치·연속 처리 순서는 원작에서도 보존 자료의 한계 안에 남는다.

두 원작의 구조는 서울의 제도를 비교하는 근거다. 보존 문서에서 확인한 범위이며 게임 실행 관찰은 아니다. 문서 판본과 역사 빌드의 대응이 확인되지 않은 자료도 있어 해당 빌드에서의 실제 동작까지 확정할 수는 없다.

## 9. 결정할 구체적인 대안

아래는 채택 전 제안이다. 어느 대안도 숫자·인준자·기간을 승인한 것으로 소비하지 않는다.

| 항목 | 소비자 용도·이상 | 현재 공백·이유 | 구체적 대안 | QA 질문 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 세력·도시별 후보·선출·정족수·동점·인준 | 제도 담당자가 적격자를 근거 있는 수장으로 확정 | 시작 방식 이름만 있고 선출 상세가 미정 | 선거형은 등록된 유권 명부와 인준으로 확정 또는 회의 합의로 확정; 동수는 재표결 또는 인준기관 중재 뒤 확정 | 동수·후보 소진·누락 표에서 근거 없는 수장이 생기지 않는가? |
| 세습과 가족법 | 계보와 공직 자격을 따로 검사 | 혼인·양자·적격 자녀 순서·예외가 세력별 미정 | 적격 계보 순서를 따르되 인준 또는 가문 지명 후 독립 인준 | 새 몸과 수장이 같아도 독립 근거가 있는가? 관계 표기만으로 상속되지 않는가? |
| 함께 정하는 자리(추대·대주회·네 곁집 자리) | 복수 기구의 역할을 일관되게 연결 | 도장이 다 모이지 않을 때·이름값이 붙을 때·곁집 다툼의 처리 순서 미정 | 정해진 자리의 절차로만 수장을 확정하고, 실패하면 공석을 유지하거나 등록된 권한대행이 결재 범위만 맡음 | 한 자리 공석이 다른 자리 권한을 자동 흡수하지 않는가? |
| 대행·섭정 | 공석 업무와 기존 수장 보조를 구별 | 등록 주체·범위 변경·해제·기간 미정 | 사전 등록 범위만 유지 또는 별도 적법한 기관 결정으로 범위를 변경 | 등록 없는 인물과 범위 밖 요청을 막는가? |
| 정통성 | 인준·협조·분쟁의 근거를 보여 줌 | 기록할 사실·수치·문턱값 미정 | 인준과 분쟁의 사건 기록만 표시 또는 별도 승인된 수치·고정 분류를 추가 | 개인 지지 변화가 고정 문턱 자체를 바꾸지 않는가? |
| 작위·인준·전쟁 효과 | D10의 권리·수혜자 판단, D16의 명분·전쟁 종결, D17의 협상·정산을 연결 | 실제 작위·영역·상위 계약·인준기관·세부 종결 효과 미정 | 기관의 인정 문서로 권리 확정 또는 당사자 합의 후 별도 인준 | 공격자와 수혜자를 구별하고 계속 유효한 명분만 종결하는가? |
| 무영토 조직 | 잔존 신원과 의무를 적법하게 처리 | 잔존 방향은 선택됐으나 대표·보관자·해산 절차 미정 | 기존 유효 대표 유지 또는 적법한 기관 절차로 제한 보관자 지정 | 사망·영토 상실만으로 삭제하지 않고 무권한 대표도 만들지 않는가? |
| 조직 가치·정보 공개 | 지지 판단과 기록 열람을 설계 | 가치 목록은 제안이며 열람권 미정 | 공개 인준·공석만 표시 또는 권한별 상세 장부 공개; 가치 변화는 사건 기록과 별도 정책 개정으로 구분 | 이름 검색과 ID 동일성, 비공개 정보 경계가 유지되는가? |
| 건강·파생 능력의 직위 자격 | 자격 제안자가 개인 계산을 기관 자격과 연결 | 원본 Basic 및 해당 계산 승인 없음 | 건강 수치 없이 독립 제도 자격만 사용 또는 원본과 계산 승인 후 별도 개인 결과를 읽음 | 공개 발췌·Lite로 원본을 대체하거나 미승인 점수를 넣지 않는가? |

정통성 점수·시험 점수·정족수·대행 기간·새 비용은 승인된 숫자가 없다. 건강이나 파생 능력을 직위 자격에 사용할지, 사용한다면 어떤 기준으로 후보를 구분할지는 아직 정해지지 않았다.

title: D10 Title, Rights, Justification, Ratification
body_md:
# D10 Title, Rights, Justification, Ratification

## Game Logic Overhaul Alignment Boundary

This document retains its existing proposal status. The formulas, tables, and blueprints are neither implementation facts of Seoul nor approved figures. The Seoul-fact / CK3-reference / product-authority distinctions in the linked chapters below and SP-1.0.0 take precedence, and undecided values are not interpreted as 0 or any arbitrary default. The deep-survey discrepancy totals and clan formulas are not adopted.

[Corresponding Chapters and Confirmed Grounds](/gdd/rules/power-and-institutions/)

Status: Proposed. This distinguishes approved rules, selected policies, unadopted alternatives, and undecided values. It does not mean implementation is complete.

[Design Guide](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index/) · [Situations and Cases](/gdd/system-design/domain-situations/) · [Sheets and Calculations](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/)

This document describes situations in which a person holds a right but does not control the land, wars that support another person's claim, and situations in which rights and on-site takeover diverge after a war. Existing approved provisions are kept, and the undecided institutions for each faction are separated into the options that follow. The options are not adopted rules. Dependent scopes for which the original Basic's identification, rules, errata, and personal judgment inputs have not been secured remain unclosed.

## 1. Actors and Player Decisions

The player is a single main-body character, and NPCs follow the same action contract. There is one world time. Moving between screens does not duplicate the main body or rewind time. Combat has no pause, speed control, or command queue. The player decides on submitting their own grounds, requesting mediation or support, receiving lawful grants, issuing commands with authority, and making demands and offers in negotiation proposals. Having a right does not mean one can declare war on behalf of a faction.

| Actor | Decisions Available | Separately Required Conditions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Unaffiliated, Officeless Person | Request employment, joining, or mediation; request war support for one's own claim | Joining first is required to receive a faction grant of a title domain; command authority is required to lead faction troops |
| Faction-Affiliated, Officeless Person | Service or duty contracts under the institution; petitions for grants | Declaring war in the faction's name, disposing of public assets, and ratifying records require separate authority |
| Claimant / Succession Candidate | Submit evidence, assert succession eligibility, request support, and be a candidate beneficiary of a casus belli | A claim in itself is not ownership, possession, or effective control |
| Title Holder | Operation, income, and duties under the contract; claims for restoring rights; permitted sub-grants | Cannot immediately use facilities they do not possess, nor arbitrarily create titles of equal or higher rank |
| Record, Notarization, and Genealogy Officer | Compose claims on the orders of a head or office holder with authority | Requires the relevant duty authority and accessible record, genealogy, and ratification channels; direct operation by an officeless main body is not adopted |
| Head of a Faction or City | Appointments, grant proposals, diplomacy, and war authorization under its institutions | Does not gain another faction's ratification authority or an unconditional right of revocation |
| Occupier | Security, supply, and negotiation within the area actually controlled | Occupation alone does not yield lawful inheritance, ownership of institutional treasuries, or the cooperation of residents |

An appointed commander issues orders within a valid command scope over all squads assigned to them. One army has one commander (D3); squads receive the order immediately, carry it out, and have no authority to move on their own. Any part that could not be carried out (a blocked path, inability) and actual results are recorded separately, and the evaluator is the original issuing commander who sent the order. Even if the commander is replaced, the original issuer and history of existing orders, evaluations, and memories are preserved, and the remaining orders are rechecked under the new commander's authority. A title or office tier does not create command authority over another commander's units. Any unit that actually arrives at an ongoing battle may join it as reinforcement. Approval or dispatch alone does not make a unit appear on site, and reinforcement participation is not restricted by tally boundaries, initial composition, departure point, or rank. This is a linking condition to avoid confusing the transfer of rights with participation in battle.

## 2. Distinguishing Qualification from Rights

Every person may hold a list of right instances if they have eligible grounds. The permanent ID of the person and the right, type, target, grounds, issuing or succession event, effect, ratifying party, version, and inheritance and extinction conditions are distinguished. The list is an interface, not permission for free trade or duplication. Rights can be searched by name, and identity is confirmed by a stable ID. Names or holders in old registries are historical evidence, not authority that determines the current world's holders or institutions.

| Claim Status | Already Accepted Handling | Institutions Still Needed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Latent Claim | Attributed to the designated succession eligibility while the current holder is alive | Links between children's eligibility, succession outside bloodlines, and office succession versus title succession |
| Enforced Claim | Basis for lawful succession and restoration of rights; when the holder dies, it becomes an unenforced claim passed to eligible children | Eligible children, and each faction's confirmation, marriage, and succession exceptions |
| Unenforced Claim | Not inherited separately; a white peace in the war over that claim turns it into an enforced claim | Conditions for claim extinction, loss of eligibility, and voiding a war by casus belli |

Title-holding rights follow that title's succession system. Eligibility for public office, voting rights, and technical qualifications are not the same kind of thing as a title claim. Improving or worsening personal relationships changes the grounds for support or acceptance; it does not mean the boundaries of a fixed comparison category, such as a rank tier, have shifted. High trust also cannot substitute for physical impossibility or lack of authority.

Marriage follows each faction's political, property, and succession systems, as well as the consent and confirmation of the parties. Establishing a marriage alone does not grant new claims or territory, nor does it share all of the spouse's claims. Using a spouse's existing claim, children inheriting a claim, and fabricating a claim separate from succession rights are different paths. When a death, imprisonment, or loss of office occurs, check for each alliance, property, confirmation, and heir effect whether it is maintained, terminated, or must be re-confirmed.

## 3. Before, During, and After an Action, and Failure

Before an action, check in order: the target's existence and version, feasibility (such as whether the actor is alive and not imprisoned), authority, the actual location and communication route, resources and exclusive reservations, and the other party's will and institutional procedures. The player is shown the satisfied conditions and the blocked conditions, distinguished by what the current body's knowledge, records, and access to reports and qualifications can confirm. Hidden facts are not leaked through the stated reason; they are explained as a lack of confirmed grounds. Unknown prices or faction systems are not filled in as success conditions.

Claim fabrication is divided into gathering and drafting evidence → composing the claim → recognition of its effect or rejection. Fabrication takes time, and only a structure that checks duration, cost, and risk of detection has been approved. Seoul's numbers and success determinations are undecided. Completing a fabrication is neither possession nor a transfer of holding rights. If a death, dismissal, occupation, or loss of contact occurs between approval and execution, the remaining work is checked again. Even if it is canceled by a world event or the person in charge dies, materials already consumed and progress already completed are not reversed; only the remaining reservations are released according to the contract.

A grant proceeds through draft → authority and target check → recipient consent → required confirmation or ratification → rights ledger change → operational takeover. One must join the faction before receiving a grant, and a head may grant only titles lower than their own. The limit of two directly held duchies (districts) is an existing confirmed value. At the 2126 opening each of the 25 duchies has one holder (Bible 2.4). No new title is created where no actual title ID, domain, or rank exists. The holder is not changed before the required confirmation. If on-site takeover is blocked after confirmation, the result remains as rights held but not recovered, or takeover incomplete.

An established grant removes the right from the grantor's list and registers the same title ID to the recipient. Delegation leaves the original holder in place and entrusts only specified operations, signing, or command. Appointment grants public office authority. Buildings, institutional vaults, public stockpiles, and unit command do not transfer automatically unless their inclusion is explicitly stated. Revocation requires contract clauses, evidence of violation, and a confirmation procedure. Unlawful seizure is not a normal grant but a change of control and a rights dispute.

Switching the current body, replacing the head of a faction or institution, and succession to individual titles and property are separate events. A lawful procedure reselecting the same living person is also not inheritance upon death. Even if the body changes because of permanent imprisonment, the imprisoned person remains alive. The previous body's rights, authority, skills, and friends are not copied to the new body. The death of a proxy does not extinguish the original holder's rights. A vacancy is not an automatic dissolution of a faction or institution.

## 4. Casus Belli, War Score, and Negotiation

Holding a casus belli does not grant authority to declare war, troops, or command. Every war requires a validly registered casus belli at its start. The actor's authority, the opponent, the target title and domain, the beneficiary, eligibility, cost, objectives, and the effects of attacker victory, defender victory, white peace, surrender, and voiding are all fixed. Restoring a recognized right, supporting another eligible person's claim, and remedying a breach of an approved higher-level contract are bundles for registration review, not a finished list of casus belli. Personal debts, passage disputes, and water supply cutoffs are not automatically made into grounds for conquest.

When supporting another person's claim, the beneficiary named in that casus belli is the standard. The attacker is not given all the territory. The new holder and higher-level contracts are checked. A war refers to the casus belli version at the time it began, and if the grounds change, the voiding conditions of that casus belli are explicitly checked. Occupation outside the objectives does not widen the scope of transfer. Effective control, legal confirmation, title rights, public office, and personal property are independent. The transfer of rights at termination does not mean residents' cooperation, restoration of facilities, or completed integration.

War score W ranges from -100 to 100, and the opponent's is -W. In a war between heads, the combat score is capped at 50. Capturing the actual head of that war is +100; capturing the designated primary, second, and third heirs is +50, +25, and +10; and occupying the capital is +10. For a single war or event ID, the addition applies only once, and the same person or the same event is not counted twice. A candidate for a seat filled by acclamation or name-worth is not arbitrarily designated as the primary heir. +30 makes a white peace request possible but is not automatic acceptance. Voluntary surrender follows the result defined by each casus belli.

Occupation contribution is based on the scope and scale of the strongholds the defender holds. If full control of the casus belli's objectives persists, cumulative contribution over time is gained, and if part of it is recovered, the conditions are checked again. Duration during which the attacker fails to secure the objectives contributes to the defending side. The denominator, partial occupation, duration, rate of increase, and peace acceptance modifiers are undecided. A tactical victory alone does not automatically dissolve an organization that holds no territory.

If W=100, the opponent's forced acceptance of -100 is recorded, and the war is immediately terminated and settled with the victory and defeat effects of the casus belli. No additional captures, occupations, or property demands are accumulated during the response delay. If the casus belli is already void, the voiding conditions are checked first. +100 is not authority to forcibly acquire territory, assets, or persons outside the objectives.

A negotiation proposal has the war and proposal versions, signing authority, the target and beneficiary, a list of items, and the timing, deadline, and breach effects of performance. Items distinguish promises such as rights transfers, asset payments and returns, prisoner release and repatriation, passage, water supply, rations, escorts, confirmations, higher-level contracts, and ceasefires. Trading in persons, forced marriage, and general assignment without consent are not allowed. Each item's ID, quantity, scope, authority to dispose, valuation inputs, price version, and feasibility are checked, and the same ledger asset is not demanded twice. The negotiation price score and the war score are separate records, and negotiation neither consumes nor manipulates the combat score.

In an interim negotiation, the player may reduce the demands within the casus belli or propose mutually agreed substitute payments or obligations. Assets, persons, and territory the opponent cannot dispose of, and third parties' rights, cannot be included. Forced cession outside the objectives is not allowed, and a voluntary separate transaction is not disguised as a forced effect. The evaluation structure is the sum of the demanded items' prices minus the sum of the offered items' prices, and acceptance considers not only the score but also control, supply, succession, prisoners, obligations, relationships, memory, and feasibility. A proposal is not automatically accepted merely because its price is at or below the score. Unregistered items appear as 'valuation pending' and block signing and settlement of a finalized proposal.

Time and combat continue during negotiation. If ±100 is reached before acceptance, forced termination by casus belli takes precedence and the unaccepted proposal is discarded. For acceptance, 100, and death at the same boundary, only one termination is determined by the confirmed event order and versions. Termination proceeds through input lock → recheck of casus belli and beneficiary → rights transfer → occupation retention or return → prisoner handling → reparations, ceasefire, and higher-level contracts → cancellation and recheck of orders in progress → event record. Deliveries, repatriations, and follow-up obligations after signing are not copied at the moment before completion.

## 5. Information the Player Reads and Domain Ownership

The rights and casus belli screens display only information that the current body's knowledge, access to records and reports, and qualifications can confirm. Within that scope, the rights screen distinguishes a person's searchable name and ID; the right's type, target, grounds, effect, confirmation, and version; and the current legal holder versus the on-site possessor. Under the same access conditions, the casus belli screen distinguishes the attacker and beneficiary, the target domain, and each termination effect and voiding condition. The internal ledgers of rights, control, and world facts are maintained separately from what the character knows, and viewing a screen does not reveal hidden world facts. Unconfirmed information is shown as unknown or as lacking confirmed grounds, and even a rejection reason does not leak hidden facts. When the body changes, the display of reports and records is rechecked against the new character's knowledge, qualifications, and access. If simultaneous changes conflict on the same ledger version, they are resolved by a deterministic acceptance order and other settlements are reviewed again. Resending the same event does not create a new right. A rules version mismatch or corrupted save is an explicit error, and there is no automatic renumbering, migration, or silent mixing of rules.

D10 covers the types of rights, claim states, and the boundaries of a casus belli's target and beneficiary. The factions and government domain (D09) owns the confirming bodies and each faction's qualifications, elections, and acting arrangements, and the grant domain (D11) owns grant, delegation, and revocation contracts. The house and relationship domain owns the establishment of marriage and relationships between the parties, and the succession domain owns death and body transitions. D15 (combat, command, squads, roster size) covers actual tactical combat, orders, squads, and capture results observed on site. D16 (diplomacy, war, sieges, prisoners) owns the campaign contracts for war, diplomacy, sieges, and prisoners, and checks whether an observed individual detention result corresponds to the institutional figure in that war, along with its campaign effects. D17 (negotiation, trade, peace, contracts) owns negotiation proposals, trades, peace, and performance contracts. The asset domain owns property attribution and delivery. This explanation of the connections does not approve any domain's undecided costs or systems.

## 6. Cases Where Outcomes Diverge

**The Landless Claimant.** Garam, previously unaffiliated and holding no office, holds a claim, and another person possesses the objective. Garam asks an authorized head for support. Without a valid registered casus belli, no war is created, and the claim and possession remain as they are. Because the records officer has no valid order, fabrication does not begin either. Accepting the request and registering are separate conditions.

**Termination of a War Supporting Another's Claim.** Previously, the attacker Narae is at war under a valid casus belli supporting the claim of the beneficiary Daon. Even if Narae occupies a stronghold outside the objectives and the score reaches +100, the casus belli and beneficiary are rechecked before settlement. If valid, only that version's target is processed with Daon as the standard, and higher-level contracts are checked. Narae does not acquire all the territory, and no institutional vault is transferred. If it is already void, the voiding effects apply. Even when rights are transferred, on-site takeover and restoration may remain.

**Selection upon Death and Survival.** Before death, Raon holds pressed claims and institutional offices. On death, the path leading to an unpressed claim is checked for eligible children, but child eligibility requires input from the faction's institution. Institutional property, offices, and the player's main body are not copied along with it. Under permanent detention, death inheritance is not opened. A living Raon retaking an office through lawful reselection is likewise not a claim-inheritance event.

**Interrupted Record Work.** Beforehand, the person in charge wrote up some materials and consumed supplies in authorized claim-construction work. If dismissal, death, or loss of access blocks the remaining work, completed progress and consumption are preserved, and the remaining reservations are released under the contract. Unfinished work is not turned into a completed claim or territory. Who takes over the remaining progress is an option below.

## 7. Confirmed Structures of the Two Originals and Differences from Seoul

The verified sources for CK3 are the preserved scripts of 1.20.0.3, build 25652598, and a community wiki from a separate point in time. Title hierarchy and de jure parents, actual holders, terrain, and offices are different scopes. A claim changes as a character–title relationship and is not evidence of a tradable inventory item. Fabrication leads, after work progress, to events, payments, and the granting of unpressed claims, and differs from occupation. A white peace strengthens only the weak claims on the target list, while defeat or surrender handles the corresponding claim. Title and vassal transactions from victory are separate from changes in occupation control. Automatic death inheritance, list storage, native enumeration, rounding, and active paths still have verification limits.

Differences among CK3 sources are also retained. The wiki description of a fixed 20% for duchy fabrication is not the same as a conditional weighted branch. The old path of requesting from a religious head is distinguished as a pressed claim, while Buy Claim is distinguished as payment in faith resources and an unpressed claim, and differs from the path of buying things with gold. Partial costs of supporting another house's claim are not read as the final war declaration cost. The powerful-vassal condition for creating an empire is 'at least half' under the default-disabled rule, not an unconditional majority-ratification law. We do not write that the confirmed title-tier symbol mapping is 'unrecovered,' but we also do not say that native automatic calculation has been confirmed. PAM requests, old requests, empire rules, and de jure changes are different paths. These figures, probabilities, and religious institutions are not transplanted into Seoul.

Norland distinguishes the World 1284, Lords 1314, Actions 1318, and States 1262 wiki versions from individual beta/main developer announcements. Grant Title and recall are character roles, not Seoul's grants of territorial titles. Region, city, and town terrain are not grantable legal titles. Gold plundering, relationship changes, and vassalization from ordinary city attacks are separate transitions, so victory is not read as ownership. Peace treaty expiration is not claim expiration, and lowborn and lesser lord are not the lowest tier of territorial titles. The emperor condition counts the number of states; it is not a title tier.

Norland's vassal action restrictions, qualitative tribute dependence, and the order of demand, refusal, and victory are limited to their respective document versions. The Patches 54–56 MAIN announcement states that a neighboring state newly vassalized by a player cannot rebel for 3 in-game days. This is not a general protection that also prevents invasion or title recall. The timer start, refresh, native application, and correspondence to the actual build are unconfirmed. The Debt of Honor vassalization path in beta57 is separate evidence from a separate version. The pre-hire requirement in beta40 and the combined Hire and Grant Title command in beta54 are version changes. The inauguration occurring after a grant in main50–53 does not prove a transaction that requires legal ratification beforehand. Transfer of ruler status and succession preservation are ruler-status and role states, not a universal hierarchy of title rights. Tribute calculation, AI acceptance, hidden conditions, and the native application order are unconfirmed. Seoul's pre-grant ratification is based on Seoul's approval clause.

## 8. Unapproved Options: Purpose, Ideal, Gaps, Reasons, QA

The following are alternatives for filling real gameplay gaps, and none of them has been selected. The originals' unconfirmed algorithms are not filled in with 0 or 'none.'

| Question and Purpose | Ideal Outcome | Specific Alternatives and Reasons for Choosing | Remaining Gaps and Verification Cases (QA) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GP-07 · Faction Institutions: Fixing the Target of Grant and Ratification | The current title and the jurisdictional institution are clear | A: ratification by each faction's central register (in the Government, the resident register); B: ratification by the institution of the relevant district or city. A makes conflicts easy to compare, while B expresses decentralized institutions. | Actual IDs, territories, holders, superior contracts, and institutions are undecided. Check that when an old registry differs from current control, each is displayed and no nonexistent ID is generated. |
| GP-09 · Faction Family Law: Eligible Persons for Latent and Inherited Claims | The claim path is not confused with office and property eligibility | A: among children recognized by the faction, those eligible under the relevant title law; B: after recognizing the parent–child relationship, eligibility is finalized by a separate title ratification. A has a simpler procedure, while B separates family law from rights law. | Rules for biological children, adoptees, consent, marriage, and non-bloodline succession are undecided. Both alternatives preserve the pressed→unpressed child path and the non-inheritance of unpressed claims; check that automatic sharing with a spouse is prohibited. |
| T68-D09-COUNTRY-LAWS · Faction Institutions (Unapproved): Handling Election Vacancies, Ratification, Regency, and Acting Authority | Confirm the voters, candidates, assembly quorum, tie handling, and basis of legitimacy, and distinguish provisional authority from formal tenure | A: representatives from each faction's electoral roll confirm the assembly's quorum requirements and elect, ties are sent back to a re-election procedure, and a registered acting officer performs only the specified custody and handover duties. B: an assembly of eligible representatives from each faction nominates candidates, a separate ratifying body adjudicates tie disputes, and a registered regent performs only the specified delegated duties. A emphasizes tracing electoral responsibility, while B emphasizes separating election from ratification. Neither option adopts a replacement for each faction's existing election, hereditary, or appointment method. | Actual voter and candidate rolls, assembly quorum rules, the body and procedure for resolving ties, the registration, termination, and signing scope of regents and acting officers, and the evidence and effect of ratification and legitimacy are undecided. Do not invent quorum numbers, legitimacy thresholds, or faction law. QA: check that missing voters, a failed quorum, or a tie never result in writing that a formal transfer of rights has taken place; that institutional continuity is preserved during a vacancy; that the authority check blocks a registered acting officer who requests an out-of-scope grant or war approval; and that regency ratification does not turn into an automatic transfer of personal property or titles. |
| T68-D10-RIGHTS-LIFECYCLE: Transfer and Extinction | Can explain the effect and reason for each right and the validity of the current casus belli | A: review per event of the basis's extinction; B: renewal review per type of right and re-check upon extinction of the basis. A avoids unnecessary deadlines, while B expresses a record-renewal system. | Transferable types, inheritance exceptions, expiration periods, and ratifying bodies are undecided. If extinction overlaps with +100, check validity first; check that no common success roll or common TTL is created. |
| Duration, Cost, and Risk of Claim Construction, and Interrupted Progress | Record access and the responsible authority are linked to actual costs | A: cost per ratification stage and a successor's re-check of existing records; B: full cost of the work contract and performance of the remaining work after approval of the takeover. A emphasizes responsibility per stage, while B emphasizes contract predictability. | Amounts, durations, detection effects, and successor takeover conditions are undecided. Check that direct manipulation by those without office is blocked, that what is already consumed or completed is preserved, and that unfinished work is not turned into a right. |
| GP-13: Casus Belli, Negotiation, Truce, and Reparations | The scope of coercion and voluntary transactions can be compared | A: an itemized price list per casus belli; B: a per-faction evaluation table fixed to the casus belli version. A emphasizes comparative consistency, while B expresses institutional differences. | Casus belli registration, costs, truces, reparations, and acceptance adjustments are undecided. Check that automatic acceptance at V≤W is prohibited, that signing unregistered items is blocked, and that beneficiaries and attackers are distinguished. |
| Occupation and Objective Time Score | Control recovery and the basis of the score can be explained | A: sum of contributions per approved stronghold; B: sum of contributions weighted by approved scale. A suits comparing strongholds, while B suits expressing differences in scale. | The denominator, partial occupation, duration, and growth rate are undecided. Check that cumulative conditions are re-checked when part of an objective is recovered, and that the cap of 50 on battles between heads is preserved. |
| Non-Bloodline Succession, Special Regimes, and Unaffiliated Armies | Only key figures under the actual institution correspond to the capture score | A: only registered institutional successors correspond to existing items; B: regimes with no correspondence get a separate effect approved. A minimizes misidentification, while B suits expressing non-hereditary institutions. | Correspondence inputs and separate effects are undecided. Candidates for seats filled by acclamation or name-worth are not arbitrarily made principal heirs. Check that the scope of claims on the lowest-tier title and the independent casus belli for each of the four tiers are also separately approved. |
| T68-D11-CONTRACT-RECALL: Grant, Delegation, and Recall Handover | Distinguish legal rights from on-site takeover responsibility | A: staged handover after ratification; B: contractual takeover confirmation after ratification. A emphasizes visibility of on-site disputes, while B emphasizes tracing contractual responsibility. | Obligations, consent, expiration, costs, and recall conditions are undecided. Check that the original holder is retained upon delegation, that rights are preserved after the agent's death, and that automatic transfer of treasuries and troops is prohibited. |

The original Basic dependency judgment and the generation of personal combat in sieges and captures are not closed by these options. Organizing the approval structure so that it can be read, finalizing faction-specific policies and figures, and completing implementation are different outcomes.
