| 항목 가격 | V 계산·제안 비교 | A: 항목 종류별 기본가와 상태 보정 판본, B: 거래 유형별 별도 평가기 | 같은 상태·판본에서 같은 가격, 미등록은 명시적 미정 | 가격표·부호·상하한·반올림·갱신 규칙 미승인 | 미등록/0가격/양수/음수 항목을 분리 계산하고 판본 변경 전후를 비교 |
| 수락·거절·역제안 | NPC와 플레이어 응답 | A: 설명 가능한 다요인 점수 뒤 세 갈래 선택, B: 필수 조건 필터 뒤 정책별 평가 | V 비교가 동의를 대신하지 않고 거절 이유가 추적됨 | 계수·문턱·동점·역제안 생성 규칙 미승인 | 같은 V에서 관계·포로·이행 가능성만 바꿔 독립 결과 확인 |
| 예약 시점과 독점성 | 중복 약속 방지 | A: 확정안 제출 때 임시 예약, 서명 때 확정, B: 서명 때만 원자 예약 | 이중 지출 없이 취소 가능 | 예약 선점·만료·충돌 우선순위 미승인 | 두 안이 같은 자산을 요구할 때 하나만 확정되는지 검증 |
| 제안 만료와 세계 변경 | 낡은 안 재검사 | A: 기한+관련 원장 판본 변경 시 만료, B: 기한만 만료하고 서명 때 전면 재검사 | 낡은 권한이나 사망한 서명자로 정산하지 않음 | 만료 조건과 재검사 범위 미승인 | 권한 변경·사망·자산 이동을 각각 넣어 서명 차단 확인 |
| 인도·위반·부분 이행 | 서명 뒤 캠페인 계약 | A: 항목별 독립 이행과 잔여 추적, B: 묶음 계약의 단계별 이행 | 서명, 권리, 예약, 물리 인도가 분리되고 완료분은 보존됨 | 인도 시간·부분 이행·위반 효과·배상 미승인 | 0%, 일부, 전부 인도 뒤 취소·사망을 각각 계산 |
| 가족·가산 수혜 | 혼인·상속·공동재산 항목 | A: 기존 가족 계약의 고정 수혜자, B: 당사자 동의로 별도 수혜 계약 | 공격자와 수혜자를 혼동하지 않음 | 지분·담보·경합 거래와 세력별 법 미승인 | 동일 자산에 배우자·가산·채권자가 있는 사례를 분리 |
| 동일 시각 종결 | 수락·±100·사망 경쟁 | A: 인과 그래프 뒤 입장 서수, B: 승인된 도메인 우선순위표 | 정산 하나만 생기고 재현 가능 | 사건 종류 간 최종 우선순위 미승인 | 세 사건의 입력 순열을 모두 재생해 단일 결과 확인 |
| 전쟁·외교 제도 계약(GP-13) | 명분 목록·선전 비용·휴전·배상·상위 계약 | A: 세력별 등록 제도 판본이 허용 항목과 조건을 제공, B: 공통 계약 틀에 세력별 승인 모듈을 결합 | 유효 명분과 자발적 거래의 범위가 분명하고 세력별 법을 임의로 만들지 않음 | GP-13은 미승인이다. 명분 목록, 비용, 기간, 배상, 휴전과 상위 계약의 조건·효과가 정해지지 않음 | 선택한 제도 판본마다 명분 생성, 선전, 목표 밖 요구, 휴전 중 재선전, 배상·상위 계약 이행을 독립 검증 |

전쟁·외교 제도는 위 대안 중 하나를 선택한 뒤 명분 목록, 선전 비용, 휴전, 배상과 상위 계약의 각 조건을 별도로 승인·등록해야 한다. 권리 회복, 적격 타인 주장 지원, 상위 계약 의무 위반 구제는 등록 후보 묶음이지 승인된 명분 목록이 아니다. 수장 사망이나 영토 상실만으로 조직이 자동 소멸하는 규칙도 정해지지 않았다.

Basic 원문·규칙·정오표와 정확한 판본이 필요한 계산은 입력 미정으로 남는다. 가격이 개인 전투나 기술 성과를 읽게 되더라도, 그 값을 0이나 임의 계수로 대신하지 않는다. 가격 수치, 수락 함수, 가족법, 인도 시간과 제도별 효과는 별도 승인이 필요하다.

## 10. 두 원작 비교 자료의 현재 검증 범위

**Crusader Kings III.** 비교에 사용한 보존 문서·스크립트는 버전 `1.20.0.3`, 빌드 `25652598`에 묶여 있다. 전쟁·백지 강화·항복·인질 이동·석방·선물의 일부 조건과 순서를 비교할 수 있지만, 활성 DLC·모드·플레이세트·브랜치와 네이티브 실행, AI 수락 문턱, 세계 이동·경로·속도, 롤백·저장 지속성은 확인되지 않았다. 이 판본 핀은 현재 설치 동작이나 서울의 가격·수락 규칙을 승인하지 않는다.

**Norland.** 비교 자료는 역사 문서, 위키, MAIN/BETA 패치와 수리 기록마다 서로 다른 권위 범위를 가진다. `25211575-patch-unmapped`에 연결된 역사 매개변수도 단위·연산자·소비자·호출 상태와 현재 적용성을 알 수 없어 메커니즘 수치로 쓰지 않는다. 이동, 구금, 거래 인도는 서로 다른 범위이며, 관계 100은 전쟁 점수나 자동 서명이 아니다. 이 자료도 현재 설치 판본이나 네이티브 동작, 서울 승인, 가격식, 수락 점수, 예약·위반·부분 반환 순서를 입증하지 않는다.

두 게임의 항목 가격, 소득 배수, 자동 수락 수, 기간, 이동 보정과 알림 순서는 비교 자료다. 서울의 수치나 정책으로 채택하지 않았다.

title: D18 Time, Events, Campaign, and Saving — Play Rule Design
body_md:
# D18 Time, Events, Campaign, and Saving — Play Rule Design

## Game Logic Overhaul Alignment Boundary

This document retains its existing proposal status. The formulas, tables, and blueprints are neither implementation facts of Seoul nor approved figures. The Seoul-fact / CK3-reference / product-authority distinctions in the linked chapters below and SP-1.0.0 take precedence, and undecided values are not interpreted as 0 or any arbitrary default. The deep-survey discrepancy totals and clan formulas are not adopted. v3 alignment: one commander commands every squad (Bible 2.5, D3).

[Corresponding Chapters and Confirmed Grounds](/gdd/rules/time-pulses-and-events/)

Status: proposal. This distinguishes approved rules, selected policies, unadopted alternatives, and undetermined values. It does not mean implementation is complete. A new result ID alone does not create authority to end a war.

[Design Guide](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index/) · [Situations and Cases](/gdd/system-design/domain-situations/) · [Sheets and Calculations](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/)

## 1. Actors and What the Player Decides

One player continues a single campaign with one main-body character. All other characters are NPCs who use the same action contract as the player. A permanent ID identifies the same character, unit, right, and event regardless of name changes or namesakes, and edition conflicts are surfaced explicitly. The surface rule that gives the current world ledger priority over name searches and past approval rosters is a proposal owned by D01. D18 carries that proposal through consistently on the time and save screens but does not turn it into a new approval.

The player's actual decisions are as follows.

- The main body, as a battle commander, selects **all attached squads** within the registered command scope and issues valid orders such as movement, stance, and attack. Enemy forces, unattached independent forces, and allied forces outside the scope cannot be controlled merely because they are visible.
- One army has one commander, who commands every squad (D3). The commander's orders reach the squads immediately as a system signal, and the squads carry them out. Squads have no authority to move on their own, so a squad leader makes no choice about an order (the earlier squad-leader choice is superseded by D3). Only feasibility limits, such as a blocked path or inability to act, are recorded. A main body who is not the army's commander does not steer squads in the battle layer; duels and hero fights stay in personal resolution. After actual execution, the commander character who issued the original order owns a per-order assessment of purpose, feasibility, contribution, losses, and civilian harm, and it remains as a memory about that squad. The sender, order ID, and result ID are preserved together. There is not yet a fixed trust penalty or promotion value.
- While the absolute value of the war score is below 100, both sides can propose, reject, counter-propose, and accept negotiation proposals containing individual items. Unregistered price items cannot be signed, and a proposal is not automatically accepted merely because `proposal value <= war score`.
- The eligibility of the requester for the save UI is not yet determined. However, the points at which saving is permitted and the meaning of restoration are determined as follows.

Battle flows in real time. There is no pause, speed control, or command queue. This does not mean there are no orders themselves. Current orders are delivered immediately, and a squad carries them out as far as its current state allows.

## 2. World Time and Event Order

World time is single and recorded in integer ticks counted from the start of the campaign. A matured event produces the next simulation advance. Independent simultaneous proposals that satisfy their causal preconditions obtain a total order by admission approval order, and there is no hidden priority determined by event type alone. The exact symbolic time and remainder are preserved and are not rounded up arbitrarily.

Which admission is approved first when death, unit arrival, negotiation ratification, and the war score reaching ±100 occur at the same moment has not yet been finalized. Until it is finalized, we do not write that any event type automatically takes precedence. This gap is not an option the player chooses but an open item in the event order contract.

Random numbers separate streams by purpose, target entity, and state, and are drawn by event-key address. The same address and the same payload point to the same existing result, and a different payload is not written over the same address. The seed, hash, and numeric drawing method have not yet been approved.

## 3. Battle and Reinforcements

### Eligibility

Only squads for which the main body is the battle commander and which are in the battle session's registered scope and attachment list are controlled directly. An order received by a squad arrives immediately and the squad carries it out (D3). A main body who is not the army's commander does not steer squads.

**Any unit that has actually arrived** at a battle in progress can join as reinforcements. Origin, rank, the initial organization table, and arbitrary time windows are not additional qualifications. A unit that has not yet arrived does not participate, and strategic movement is not turned into instant teleportation.

### Before, Action, After

- Before: The battle is in progress, and the main body commands the attached squads within the registered scope. One later-arriving unit is moving along its actual route.
- Action: The commander issues an immediate order to an attached squad. The squad carries out the order, and if a path is blocked only that limit is recorded. The later-arriving unit actually arrives during the battle.
- After: Once the actual result is produced, the part that could not be carried out and performance are evaluated separately. The evaluation result is attributed to the original sending commander character, becomes the basis of that character's memory and later assignment and trust judgments, and is tied to the order ID and result ID. The evaluation stays the commander's outcome and does not pass to the squad leader. The unit that arrived becomes a reinforcement participant. A unit that has not arrived or one outside the scope does not become a controllable squad.

### Failure and Information

An impossible order is recorded as an execution failure, not as a choice made by the squad (D3). After a commander's death or a change of authority, existing orders are rechecked under the new authority while preserving the original sender and history. The display proposal is to show, within the information the current main body actually knows and its access qualifications, the commandable scope, the purpose and status of the received order, the confirmed execution result, and the time of the evidence, each distinguished. The fact that the world's actual result is preserved does not mean the entire result is disclosed immediately. The action UI distinguishes possible, prerequisites lacking, no authority, awaiting response, and institution undetermined, but explains reasons that rely on hidden facts as "insufficient confirmed evidence" so as not to leak them. Hidden evaluation coefficients and unapproved trust values are not displayed.

## 4. War, Casus Belli, and Negotiation

### Eligibility

A war can be opened only if there is a validly registered casus belli instance. A casus belli has a target, a registered eligible beneficiary, an objective, victory, defeat, white peace, and nullification effects, and validity conditions. Holding a casus belli alone does not create authority to declare war or forces, and the eligible beneficiary is fixed to the casus belli when the war begins. The war score `W` ranges from -100 to +100, and the opponent's is `-W`.

### Before, Action, After: Mid-War Negotiation

- Before: The casus belli is valid and `|W| < 100`.
- Action: Both sides propose and evaluate a negotiation proposal that lists demands and offers together. Items such as stations and rights, assets, release and repatriation of prisoners, passage, water supply, rations, escort, ratification, and truce can be used. Each item is checked for disposal authority, actual feasibility of fulfillment, casus belli scope, and the registered price edition.
- After: If accepted, authority and the ledger are rechecked, and this leads to a single termination settlement and actual delivery and fulfillment. If rejected, the war and time continue. Unregistered prices and third-party rights that cannot be disposed of are not signed.

### Before, Event, After: Forced Termination at ±100

- Before: The casus belli is valid, and the score reaches exactly +100 or -100 within the objective range.
- Event: First, read the casus belli edition and beneficiary fixed when the war began, and recheck the casus belli's validity and that beneficiary's eligibility under any change in the grounds. If it is still valid, the war is forcibly terminated immediately with that casus belli's victory or defeat effect, without separate player confirmation. NPC response delay cannot postpone termination and does not become time to pile up additional capture, occupation, or property demands. Negotiation proposals that were not accepted are discarded.
- After: Only the scope written in the casus belli passes to the termination settlement. Territory, assets, and persons outside the objective, targets the opponent cannot dispose of, and third-party rights are not transferred by force. Asset delivery and follow-up obligations after signing or termination remain as actual campaign procedures and are not copied instantly.

If the grounds for the casus belli disappeared first, the per-casus-belli nullification rule is checked before the ±100 termination effect, and no rights or transfers without grounds are created. Not every war is terminated automatically merely because a leader dies. The specific prices, quantities, and fulfillment timing of items within the objective have not yet been approved.

## 5. Saving and Restoration

### Save Eligibility

A save is made at a consistent simulation boundary where both event acceptance and outcome application are complete. Wars in progress, current orders, training, cargo, handovers, succession procedures, and reservations are saved together with their current stages. Applied outcome IDs, permanent IDs, editions, and world facts are preserved together. The world record and the facts each character knows are stored separately, and knowledge gained through reports keeps its source and verification time. After a restore, the information actually shown to the player is re-read from the current vessel's knowledge and access eligibility. The fact that stored knowledge exists does not automatically reveal records or institutional secrets to which the new vessel has no access.

### Before/Action/After: Normal restore

- Before: The save boundary is complete, the save's rules edition is compatible with the current rules, and the data is not corrupted.
- Action: Load the save.
- After: Outcomes completed at save time stay completed, in-progress procedures resume at their stages, and consumed resources and completed progress are restored as consumed and completed. The same outcome ID is not applied again, and no vessel or asset is duplicated.

Even if a world action is canceled or the person in charge dies, materials already consumed and progress already completed are not rolled back. Only the remaining reservations and resources are released or rechecked according to that action's contract. Quitting and loading are not in-world death or departure events.

### Before/Action/After: Incompatible or corrupted save

- Before: The rules edition differs or the save is corrupted.
- Action: Request a restore.
- After: The restore is explicitly refused, and the reason for the edition mismatch or corruption is shown. There is no silent repair, unapproved migration, or replacement with a new campaign. The GP-14 policy chosen by the owner goes as far as collecting errors without changing the actual world state and not creating a partial load, migration, or replacement campaign. The upper limit on the number of errors has not yet been decided.

The document format edition and the game rules edition are different values. Mixing an older save with new rules requires a separately approved succession contract.

## 6. Cargo Cutoff and Arrival

Cargo whose actual arrival is verified at or before the consumption cutoff time is included in that cutoff. If it arrives at the same time, the arrival is verified first, and then reservation, production, and consumption are processed. Cargo that arrives after the cutoff is not retroactively included in a cutoff that has already passed. Its arrival status afterward and its eligibility for the next consumption are decided by D06's movement and cargo contract, and a verification marker used for a failed cutoff alone does not determine permanent in-transit status or automatic use at the next cutoff.

The input acceptance order for independent blockade and arrival proposals at the same time as the shared daily phase is a policy chosen by the owner. Arrival is not always placed ahead of blockade, nor is the order switched to alphabetical by event name. When cargo is split, the parent cargo is removed from active stock and preserved as history, and lineage continues through two child cargoes. Recipient confirmation signatures, conflict explanations and re-proposal guidance for reservation contention, local quarantine of cargo that fails handover, and keeping reservations for undelivered cargo have also been chosen. For these seven policies, cargo eligibility, storage, and handover handling follow the contracts of D05, D06, and D13, while D18 preserves event order and save state. The specific tick length and the causal order of simultaneous events outside the scope above remain undecided.

## 7. Ownership Boundaries

| Topic | Owning Domain | Role of D18 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Squad selection, orders, execution records, and evaluation | D03·D07·D15 | Preserves time and outcome IDs and carries over the immediate-issue, no-queue contract |
| Reinforcement participation | D06·D15·D16 | D18 orders the times, and D06 verifies actual movement and arrival. D15 and D16 own the entry and participation boundaries of battles in progress |
| Casus belli creation, validity, and rights | D10·D16 | Reads the valid casus belli and its edition and applies the ±100 termination point |
| Negotiation price, settlement, and handover | D13·D16·D17 | Provides event order and saving, while each domain decides price, authority, and actual handover |
| Cargo, stock, and consumption | D05·D06 | Provides arrival and cutoff order. Does not own the quantity, storage, or consumption ledgers |
| Death, succession, and vessel transition | D12 | Saves death events and their outcomes but does not create death rules |
| Names, permanent IDs, and current character state | D01 | Preserves searchable names and stable IDs. Past registries are not used as the authority on current state |

## 8. Play Examples

### Example A — Immediate Order and a Blocked Path

The main-body commander registered in the battle session has three squads in the attachment list within their command range. The main body issues a retreat posture to all three squads. The signal arrives immediately. All three squads carry it out, but one squad cannot reach one retreat route because of a collapsed passage. The battle does not stop and no queue is created. After the actual outcome, the originating commander character separately evaluates the part that could not be carried out and the retreat result, and keeps them as the basis for their own memory and for later attachment and trust decisions. The number of squads and the amount of trust change are not approved values in this example.

### Example B — Reinforcements That Actually Arrive

While the battle is in progress, a later-arriving unit reaches the battlefield along an actual route. It is admitted as reinforcement and is not excluded for being absent from the initial roster or for having a low rank. Other units still in transit do not participate. The time taken to arrive and the entry position are separate data, and this document does not set the numbers.

### Example C — +100 and an Unaccepted Negotiation Proposal

In a valid casus belli war, the score reaches +100 while a negotiation proposal is being exchanged. The system first rechecks the casus belli edition and beneficiary fixed at the outbreak of war, together with the continuing casus belli basis and the beneficiary's eligibility to apply it. If it is still valid, the war is terminated with that casus belli's effect, without waiting for a response or requiring a confirmation button. If the basis disappeared first, the registered invalidation rules are applied and no beneficiary rights without a basis are created. The unaccepted proposal is discarded, and stations outside the objective are not transferred. The specific quantity and timing of handover within the objective are undecided.

### Example D — Arrival After the Cutoff

Cargo actually arrives after the daily consumption cutoff. That cargo is not retroactively included in the consumption of a cutoff that has already passed. Its subsequent arrival status and eligibility for the next consumption are decided separately by the D06 contract. This example does not determine automatic use at the next cutoff or a permanent in-transit state. The actual tick value of the daily phase is also undecided.

### Example E — Preserving Work Interrupted by Death

The person in charge of training or crafting dies, and the work can no longer continue. The system rechecks eligibility and the remaining reservations, but does not reverse the materials already consumed or the progress already completed. Only the remaining resources are released according to the contract. D12 owns the death outcome and succession.

## 9. Meaning of Information and Failure

The display proposal shows the following, limited by the current vessel's actual knowledge and access eligibility: the current time, the acceptance or rejection of known events and the reasons, the sender, target, and confirmed execution status of received orders, the casus belli, score, and negotiation status of known wars, the save's edition compatibility and corruption cause, and confirmed cargo arrivals. Reports carry their source and verification time, and the world's current facts are not confused with the facts a character knows. Hidden reasons are shown as "insufficient confirmed basis," and undisclosed outcomes, institutional records, and other characters' knowledge are not exposed. The stable ID determines the target. The surface priority among name search, past rosters, and the current ledger follows the D01 proposal.

Failure does not arbitrarily reset the world state. Invalid orders, incompatible saves, unregistered negotiation prices, and lack of disposal authority each reveal only reasons that can be disclosed to the current vessel and block only the relevant action. Outcomes, progress, and consumption that are already complete are neither canceled nor erased because of a death. Resending the same outcome ID does not create a new outcome.

## 10. Approved Policies and Remaining Options

The following policies have been chosen, but this does not mean implementation is complete: integer ticks, campaign epoch, total order of entry approval, advancing events at maturity, preserving remainders, separating random numbers by purpose, entity, and state, extracting event addresses, full snapshot of the reservation stage, atomic recording of state, outcome, and receipt, collecting incompatible-save errors, and shared daily cargo cutoff. For cargo, parent history with two-child splitting, recipient confirmation signatures, reservation contention explanation and re-proposal, input acceptance order for independent blockade and arrival at the same time, local quarantine on handover failure, and keeping reservations for undelivered cargo have also been chosen.

The following items have not yet been approved. The alternatives in the table are options for play rules and do not fix the current state.

| Item | Where used | Concrete Alternatives | State needed for play | Current gap and reason |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Remaining same-time entries | Cross-causality of death, arrival, ratification, and ±100 (excluding the chosen blockade and arrival order) | A: Entry ordinal after the causal dependency graph, B: Explicit priority per domain | One reproducible outcome from the same state | No GP-03 linkage decision |
| Information display | Order, war, and cargo status known to the vessel | A: Show only accessible information with source and verification time, B: Summary within the same knowledge and access limits, then open confirmed-basis details | Judgment that does not leak hidden facts | Screen layout and level of detail disclosure undecided; stored knowledge is not disclosure authority |
| Save requester | Save UI | A: Reflect player requests at the next completed boundary, B: Save only system checkpoints | Player actions and world events are not mixed | Request authority not approved |
| Negotiation price and acceptance | Mid-term reinforcement | A: Registered per-item prices and multi-factor acceptance, B: Lock items with no registered price | Signing without arbitrary values | No coefficients or data version |
| Delivery within the target | Fulfillment after forced termination | A: Actual delivery after the right is confirmed, B: Delivery after conditional custody | Separation of rights and physical delivery | Quantity and timing not approved |
| Version migration | Loading old saves | A: Explicit version migration contract, B: Keep rejecting incompatible saves | Restoration without rule mixing | No token format or migration procedure |
| Error collection limit | Save error display | A: Maximum count with truncation notice, B: Collect up to a safety limit | Deterministic, readable diagnostics | Limit not approved |
| Random number value contract | Reproduction and saving | A: Approved hash, seed, and extraction specification, B: Lock dependent features | Per-address reproduction and independent streams | Algorithm not approved |
| Time encoding | Ticks, remainders, and expiry | A: Fixed integer units and rational remainders, B: Register units per content item | Reproduction without rounding | No tick size, remainder format, or producer |

Calculations that depend on the Basic source text remain unresolved because the required certified version and source text input cannot currently be confirmed. This is not a gameplay rule option, and it does not mean that no prior research existed.

The CK3 comparison material was confirmed within the scope of developer definitions and call-site records for version 1.20.0.3, build 25652598. The order of ending a war after releasing prisoners in a local callback and the truce calculation are confirmed, but they do not prove universal event priority or full save restoration. The Norland comparison material was confirmed only within the scope of each citation's wiki oldid, the MAIN/BETA patches, and their publication dates. These are per-target sequencing and per-patch save/load fixes, not a universal ordering at the same moment, and no single installed version or native behavior representing the whole of D18 was confirmed. The correspondence between the installed build and the preserved documents is also unconfirmed. The time, cycle, score, truce, and death figures of both games are merely comparison material and are not Seoul's coefficients. Since neither study proved universal event priority, a general-purpose result ID ledger, or a general-purpose save contract, the unresolved items are not filled in with numbers from external games.

# D18 시간·사건·캠페인·저장 — 플레이 규칙 설계

## 게임 로직 개편 정합 경계

이 문서는 기존 제안 상태를 유지한다. 산식·표·청사진은 서울의 구현 사실이나 승인 수치가 아니다. 아래 연결된 장의 서울 사실/CK3 참조/제품 권한 구분과 SP-1.0.0이 우선하며 미정 값을 0 또는 임의 기본값으로 해석하지 않는다. 깊이조사의 불일치 총계·씨족 산식은 채택하지 않는다. v3 정합: 지휘관 하나가 모든 분대를 지휘한다(바이블 2.5절 D3).

[대응 장과 확인된 근거](/gdd/rules/time-pulses-and-events/)

상태: 제안. 승인된 규칙, 선택된 정책, 미채택 대안과 미정 수치를 구분한다. 구현 완료를 뜻하지 않는다. 새 결과 ID만으로 전쟁 종결 권한이 생기지 않는다.

[설계 길잡이](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index/) · [상황과 사례](/gdd/system-design/domain-situations/) · [시트와 계산](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/)

## 1. 행위자와 플레이어가 결정하는 것

한 플레이어는 한 본체 인물로 단일 캠페인을 이어 간다. 다른 모든 인물은 플레이어와 같은 행동 계약을 쓰는 NPC다. 영구 ID는 이름 변경이나 동명이인과 무관하게 같은 인물·부대·권리·사건을 식별하고, 판본 충돌은 명시적으로 드러낸다. 이름 검색과 과거 승인 명부보다 현재 세계 원장을 우선하는 표면 규칙은 D01이 소유한 제안이다. D18은 그 제안을 시간·저장 화면에서 일관되게 이어 주되 새 승인으로 만들지 않는다.

플레이어의 실제 결정은 다음과 같다.

- 전투 지휘관인 본체는 등록된 지휘 범위의 **모든 배속 분대**를 선택하고 이동·태세·공격 등 유효 명령을 내린다. 적군, 비배속 독립군, 범위 밖 동맹군은 보인다는 이유로 조작할 수 없다.
- 군대 하나에는 지휘관 하나가 있고 그 지휘관이 모든 분대를 지휘한다(D3). 지휘관의 하달은 즉시 시스템 신호로 분대에 닿고 분대는 그대로 수행한다. 분대는 따로 움직이는 권한이 없으므로 분대장이 하달을 두고 고르는 선택은 없다(예전의 분대장 선택은 D3로 대체됐다). 길이 막혔거나 수행할 수 없는 경우 같은 수행 가능성의 한계만 기록한다. 군대의 지휘관이 아닌 본체는 전투 층에서 분대를 조종하지 않으며, 결투와 영웅의 싸움은 개인 판정으로 푼다. 실제 실행 뒤에는 원 명령을 발신한 지휘관 인물이 목적, 수행 가능성, 기여, 손실과 민간 피해에 대한 명령별 평가를 소유하고 해당 분대에 대한 기억으로 남긴다. 발신자·명령 ID·결과 ID를 함께 보존한다. 고정 신뢰 페널티나 승진 수치는 아직 없다.
- 전쟁 점수의 절댓값이 100 미만인 동안 양측은 개별 항목을 넣은 협상안을 제안·거절·역제안·수락할 수 있다. 미등록 가격 항목은 서명할 수 없고, `제안 가치 <= 전쟁 점수`만으로 자동 수락하지 않는다.
- 저장 UI의 요청자 자격은 아직 정해지지 않았다. 다만 저장이 허용되는 시점과 복원의 의미는 아래와 같이 정해져 있다.

전투는 실시간으로 흐른다. 일시정지, 속도 조절, 명령 큐는 없다. 이것은 명령 자체가 없다는 뜻이 아니다. 현재 명령은 즉시 전달되고, 분대는 현재 상태에서 수행 가능한 만큼 그대로 수행한다.

## 2. 세계 시간과 사건 순서

세계 시간은 하나이며 캠페인 시작을 기산점으로 하는 정수 틱으로 기록한다. 만기된 사건이 다음 시뮬레이션 진행을 만든다. 독립적이며 인과 전제를 충족한 동시 제안은 입장 승인 순서로 총순서를 얻고, 사건 종류만으로 정한 숨은 우선순위는 없다. 정확한 상징 시각과 잔여를 보존하며 임의로 올림하지 않는다.

같은 시각에 사망, 부대 도착, 협상 비준, 전쟁 점수 ±100 도달이 함께 생길 때 어떤 입장이 먼저 승인되는지는 아직 확정되지 않았다. 확정 전에는 어느 사건 종류도 자동 우선한다고 쓰지 않는다. 이 공백은 플레이어가 선택하는 옵션이 아니라 사건 순서 계약의 미결 사항이다.

난수는 목적·대상 엔티티·상태로 스트림을 분리하고 사건 키 주소로 추출한다. 같은 주소와 같은 페이로드는 같은 기존 결과를 가리키며, 같은 주소에 다른 페이로드를 덮어쓰지 않는다. 시드, 해시, 수치 추출법은 아직 승인되지 않았다.

## 3. 전투와 증원

### 자격

본체가 전투 지휘관이고 전투 세션의 등록 범위와 배속 목록에 들어 있는 분대만 직접 조작한다. 분대가 받는 하달은 즉시 도착하고 분대는 그대로 수행한다(D3). 군대의 지휘관이 아닌 본체는 분대를 조종하지 않는다.

진행 중인 전투에 **실제로 도착한 어느 부대든** 증원으로 참가할 수 있다. 출신, 계급, 최초 편성표, 임의 시간 창은 추가 자격이 아니다. 아직 도착하지 않은 부대는 참가하지 않으며, 전략 이동을 즉시 전송으로 바꾸지 않는다.

### 전·행동·후

- 전: 전투는 진행 중이고 본체는 등록 범위의 배속 분대를 지휘한다. 후발 부대 하나는 실제 경로로 이동 중이다.
- 행동: 지휘관은 배속 분대에 즉시 명령을 내린다. 분대는 명령을 그대로 수행하고, 길이 막히면 그 한계만 기록된다. 후발 부대가 전투 중 실제 도착한다.
- 후: 실제 결과가 나온 뒤 수행하지 못한 부분과 성과는 별도로 평가된다. 평가 결과는 원 발신 지휘관 인물에 귀속하고 그 인물의 기억과 후속 배속·신임 판단의 근거가 되며, 명령 ID와 결과 ID에 묶인다. 평가는 지휘관의 결과로 남고 분대장에게 넘어가지 않는다. 도착한 부대는 증원 참가자가 된다. 도착하지 않은 부대나 범위 밖 부대는 조작 가능 분대로 바뀌지 않는다.

### 실패와 정보

불가능한 명령은 실행 실패로 기록하고 분대가 고른 결과로 보지 않는다(D3). 지휘관 사망이나 권한 변경 뒤 기존 명령은 원 발신자와 이력을 보존한 채 새 권한으로 재검사한다. 표시 제안은 현재 본체가 실제로 아는 정보와 접근 자격 안에서 지휘 가능 범위, 수신한 하달의 목적과 상태, 확인된 수행 결과와 근거 시각을 구분해 보여 주는 것이다. 세계의 실제 결과를 보존한다는 사실이 그 결과 전체의 즉시 공개를 뜻하지 않는다. 행동 UI는 가능·선행조건 부족·권한 없음·응답 대기·제도 미정을 구분하되, 숨은 사실에 기대는 이유는 ‘확인된 근거 부족’으로 설명해 누설하지 않는다. 숨은 평가 계수나 승인되지 않은 신뢰 수치를 표시하지 않는다.

## 4. 전쟁, 명분과 협상

### 자격

전쟁은 유효하게 등록된 명분 인스턴스가 있어야 열린다. 명분은 대상, 등록된 적격 수혜자, 목표, 승리·패배·백지 강화·무효 효과와 유효성 조건을 가진다. 명분 보유만으로 선전포고 권한이나 병력이 생기지 않으며, 개전 때 적격 수혜자를 명분에 고정한다. 전쟁 점수 `W`는 -100부터 +100이며 상대는 `-W`다.

### 전·행동·후: 중간 협상

- 전: 명분이 유효하고 `|W| < 100`이다.
- 행동: 양측은 요구와 제공을 함께 적은 협상안을 제안하고 평가한다. 역·권리, 자산, 포로 석방·송환, 통행·급수·배급·호송·인준·휴전 같은 항목을 쓸 수 있다. 각 항목은 처분 권한, 실제 이행 가능성, 명분 범위와 등록된 가격 판본을 검사한다.
- 후: 수락되면 권한과 원장을 다시 검사한 뒤 단일 종결 정산과 실제 인도·이행으로 이어진다. 거절되면 전쟁과 시간이 계속된다. 미등록 가격이나 처분 불가능한 제삼자 권리는 서명되지 않는다.

### 전·사건·후: ±100 강제 종결

- 전: 명분이 유효하고 점수가 목표 범위 안에서 정확히 +100 또는 -100에 도달한다.
- 사건: 먼저 개전 때 고정한 명분 판본과 수혜자를 읽고 근거 변화에 따른 명분 유효성과 그 수혜자의 적용 자격을 다시 검사한다. 여전히 유효하면 별도의 플레이어 확인 없이 그 명분의 승리·패배 효과로 즉시 강제 종결한다. NPC 응답 지연은 종결을 미루지 못하고 추가 포획·점령·재산 요구를 쌓는 시간이 되지 않는다. 수락되지 않은 협상안은 폐기한다.
- 후: 명분에 적힌 범위만 종결 정산으로 넘어간다. 목표 밖 영토·자산·인물, 상대가 처분할 수 없는 대상, 제삼자 권리는 강제로 이전하지 않는다. 서명 또는 종결 뒤의 자산 인도와 후속 의무는 실제 캠페인 절차로 남으며 순간 복사되지 않는다.

명분 근거가 먼저 사라졌다면 ±100 종결 효과보다 명분별 무효 규칙을 먼저 검사하고 근거 없는 권리나 이전을 만들지 않는다. 수장 사망만으로 모든 전쟁을 자동 종료하지 않는다. 목표 안 항목의 구체 가격, 수량, 이행 시점은 아직 승인되지 않았다.

## 5. 저장과 복원

### 저장 자격

저장은 수락 사건과 결과 적용이 모두 끝난 일관된 시뮬레이션 경계에서 만든다. 진행 중인 전쟁, 현재 명령, 교육, 화물, 인수, 계승 절차와 예약은 각자의 현재 단계와 함께 저장한다. 적용 완료된 결과 ID, 영구 ID, 판본과 세계 사실을 함께 보존한다. 세계 기록과 각 인물이 알고 있는 사실은 별도로 저장하며, 보고를 통해 얻은 지식은 출처와 확인 시각을 유지한다. 복원 뒤 플레이어에게 실제로 표시되는 정보는 현재 본체의 지식과 접근 자격을 다시 읽는다. 저장된 지식이 있다는 사실이 새 본체에게 접근권 없는 기록이나 기관 비밀을 자동 공개하지 않는다.

### 전·행동·후: 정상 복원

- 전: 저장 경계가 완결되어 있고 저장의 규칙 판본이 현재 규칙과 호환되며 데이터가 손상되지 않았다.
- 행동: 저장을 불러온다.
- 후: 저장 당시 완료된 결과는 완료된 채로, 진행 중 절차는 그 단계에서, 소비된 자원과 완료된 진척은 소비·완료된 상태로 복원된다. 같은 결과 ID를 다시 적용하지 않고, 본체나 자산을 복제하지 않는다.

세계 행동이 취소되거나 담당자가 사망해도 이미 소비한 물자와 완료한 진척을 되감지 않는다. 남은 예약과 자원만 해당 행동 계약에 따라 해제하거나 재검사한다. 종료와 불러오기는 세계 안의 사망·이탈 사건이 아니다.

### 전·행동·후: 비호환 또는 손상 저장

- 전: 규칙 판본이 다르거나 저장이 손상되었다.
- 행동: 복원을 요청한다.
- 후: 복원을 명시적으로 거절하고 판본 불일치 또는 손상 이유를 보여 준다. 조용한 수리, 승인되지 않은 마이그레이션, 새 캠페인 대체는 없다. 소유자가 선택한 GP-14 정책은 실제 세계 상태를 바꾸지 않은 채 오류를 모으고 부분 로드·마이그레이션·대체 캠페인을 만들지 않는다는 범위까지 정했다. 오류 수 상한은 아직 정해지지 않았다.

문서 형식 판본과 게임 규칙 판본은 서로 다른 값이다. 이전 저장을 새 규칙과 섞으려면 별도로 승인된 승계 계약이 필요하다.

## 6. 화물 마감과 도착

소비 마감 시각 이하에 실제 도착이 검증된 화물은 그 마감에 포함한다. 같은 시각에 도착했다면 도착을 먼저 검증한 뒤 예약·생산·소비를 처리한다. 마감 뒤에 도착한 화물은 이미 지난 마감에 소급해 포함하지 않는다. 그 뒤의 도착 상태와 다음 소비 자격은 D06의 이동·화물 계약이 판정하며, 마감 실패용 검증 표식만으로 영구 운송 중 또는 다음 마감 자동 사용을 정하지 않는다.

공유 일간 단계와 같은 시각의 독립적인 봉쇄·도착 제안의 입력 접수 순서는 소유자가 선택한 정책이다. 도착을 항상 봉쇄보다 앞세우거나 사건 이름순으로 바꾸지 않는다. 화물을 분할하면 부모 화물은 활성 재고에서 제외해 이력으로 보존하고 두 자식 화물로 계보를 잇는다. 수령자 확인 서명, 예약 경합의 충돌 설명·재제안 안내, 인수 실패 화물의 현지 격리, 미배달 화물의 예약 유지도 선택되어 있다. 이 일곱 정책의 화물 자격·보관·인수 처리는 D05·D06·D13의 계약을 읽으며 D18은 사건 순서와 저장 상태를 보존한다. 구체 틱 길이와 위 범위를 벗어난 동시 사건의 인과 순서는 미결이다.

## 7. 소유 경계

| 주제 | 소유 도메인 | D18의 역할 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 분대 선택·명령·수행 기록·평가 | D03·D07·D15 | 시간과 결과 ID를 보존하고 즉시 하달·무큐 계약을 이어 준다 |
| 증원 참가 | D06·D15·D16 | D18은 시각을 순서화하고 D06은 실제 이동·도착을 검증한다. D15·D16은 진행 중 전투의 입장·참가 경계를 소유한다 |
| 명분 생성·유효성·권리 | D10·D16 | 유효 명분과 판본을 읽고 ±100 종결 시점을 적용한다 |
| 협상 가격·정산·인도 | D13·D16·D17 | 사건 순서와 저장을 제공하며 가격·권한·실제 인도는 각 도메인이 판정한다 |
| 화물·재고·소비 | D05·D06 | 도착과 마감 순서를 제공한다. 수량·보관·소비 장부는 소유하지 않는다 |
| 사망·후계·본체 전환 | D12 | 사망 사건과 그 결과를 저장하지만 사망 규칙을 만들지 않는다 |
| 이름·영구 ID·현재 인물 상태 | D01 | 검색 가능한 이름과 안정 ID를 보존한다. 과거 등록부를 현재 상태 권위로 쓰지 않는다 |

## 8. 플레이 예시

### 예시 A — 즉시 명령과 막힌 길

전투 세션에 등록된 본체 지휘관의 지휘 범위 안 배속 목록에 세 분대가 있다. 본체는 그 세 분대 모두에게 후퇴 태세를 내린다. 신호는 즉시 도착한다. 세 분대 모두 그대로 수행하지만 한 분대는 무너진 통로 때문에 후퇴로 하나에 닿지 못한다. 전투는 멈추지 않고 큐도 생기지 않는다. 실제 결과 뒤 원 발신 지휘관 인물이 수행하지 못한 부분과 후퇴 성과를 따로 평가하고 자기 기억과 후속 배속·신임 판단의 근거로 남긴다. 분대 수와 신뢰 변화량은 이 예의 승인 수치가 아니다.

### 예시 B — 실제 도착한 증원

전투가 진행되는 동안 후발 부대가 실제 경로를 따라 전장에 도착한다. 최초 편성표에 없거나 계급이 낮다는 이유로 배제하지 않고 증원으로 참가시킨다. 아직 이동 중인 다른 부대는 참가하지 않는다. 도착까지 걸린 시간과 진입 위치는 별도 데이터이며 이 문서가 숫자를 정하지 않는다.

### 예시 C — +100과 미수락 협상안

유효 명분 전쟁에서 협상안이 오가는 동안 점수가 +100에 닿는다. 시스템은 먼저 개전 때 고정한 명분 판본·수혜자와 계속되는 명분 근거·수혜자 적용 자격을 재검사한다. 여전히 유효하면 응답을 기다리거나 확인 버튼을 요구하지 않고 그 명분 효과로 종결한다. 근거가 먼저 사라졌다면 등록된 무효 규칙을 적용하고 근거 없는 수혜자 권리를 만들지 않는다. 미수락 안은 폐기되고 목표 밖 역은 넘어가지 않는다. 목표 안 인도의 구체 수량과 시점은 미결이다.

### 예시 D — 마감 뒤 도착

화물이 일간 소비 마감 뒤에 실제 도착한다. 그 화물은 이미 지난 마감의 소비에는 소급 포함되지 않는다. 이후 도착 상태와 다음 소비 자격은 D06 계약이 별도로 판정한다. 이 예는 다음 마감 자동 사용이나 영구 운송 중 상태를 정하지 않는다. 일간 단계의 실제 틱 값도 미결이다.

### 예시 E — 사망으로 중단된 작업의 보존

교육 또는 제작의 담당자가 사망해 작업을 계속할 수 없게 된다. 시스템은 자격과 남은 예약을 다시 검사하지만 이미 소비한 재료와 완료한 진척을 되돌리지 않는다. 남은 자원만 계약에 따라 해제한다. 사망 결과와 후계는 D12가 소유한다.

## 9. 정보와 실패의 의미

표시 제안은 현재 본체의 실제 지식·접근 자격을 한계로 현재 시각, 알려진 사건의 수락·거절과 이유, 수신한 명령의 발신자·대상·확인된 수행 상태, 알려진 전쟁의 명분·점수·협상 상태, 저장의 판본 호환 여부와 손상 사유, 확인된 화물 도착을 보여 주는 것이다. 보고에는 출처와 확인 시각을 붙이고 세계의 현재 사실과 인물이 아는 사실을 혼동하지 않는다. 숨은 이유는 ‘확인된 근거 부족’으로 표시하며 비공개 결과·기관 기록·다른 인물의 지식을 노출하지 않는다. 안정 ID가 대상을 확정한다. 이름 검색과 과거 명부·현재 원장의 표면 우선순위는 D01 제안을 따른다.

실패는 세계 상태를 임의로 초기화하지 않는다. 무효 명령, 비호환 저장, 미등록 협상 가격, 처분 권한 없음은 각각 현재 본체에게 공개 가능한 이유만 드러내고 해당 행동만 막는다. 이미 완료된 결과·진척·소비를 취소하거나 사망했다는 이유로 지우지 않는다. 같은 결과 ID의 재전송은 새 결과를 만들지 않는다.

## 10. 승인된 정책과 남은 선택지

다음 정책은 선택되었으나 구현 완료를 뜻하지 않는다: 정수 틱, 캠페인 기산점, 입장 승인 총순서, 만기 사건 진행, 잔여 보존, 목적·엔티티·상태 난수 분리, 사건 주소 추출, 예약 단계 완전 스냅샷, 상태·결과·영수증의 원자 기록, 비호환 저장 오류 모음, 공유 일간 화물 마감. 화물에는 부모 이력·두 자식 분할, 수령자 확인 서명, 예약 경합 설명·재제안, 같은 시각 독립 봉쇄·도착의 입력 접수 순서, 인수 실패 현지 격리, 미배달 예약 유지도 선택되어 있다.

다음 항목은 아직 승인되지 않았다. 표의 대안은 플레이 규칙의 선택지이며 현재 상태를 확정하지 않는다.

| 항목 | 사용처 | 구체 대안 | 플레이에 필요한 상태 | 현재 공백과 이유 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 남은 같은 시각 입장 | 사망·도착·비준·±100의 교차 인과(선택된 봉쇄·도착 순서 제외) | A: 인과 의존 그래프 뒤 입장 서수, B: 도메인별 명시 우선순위 | 같은 상태에서 하나의 재현 가능한 결과 | GP-03 연동 결정 없음 |
| 정보 표시 | 본체가 아는 명령·전쟁·화물 상태 | A: 출처·확인 시각을 붙인 접근 가능 정보만 표시, B: 같은 지식·접근 한계의 요약 뒤 확인된 근거 상세 열기 | 숨은 사실을 누설하지 않는 판단 | 화면 구성·상세 공개 수준 미결; 지식 저장은 공개 권한이 아님 |
| 저장 요청자 | 저장 UI | A: 플레이어 요청을 다음 완결 경계에서 반영, B: 시스템 검사점만 저장 | 플레이 행동과 세계 사건이 섞이지 않음 | 요청 권한 미승인 |
| 협상 가격·수락 | 중간 강화 | A: 항목별 등록 가격과 다요인 수락, B: 가격 미등록 항목 잠금 | 임의 수치 없는 서명 | 계수와 데이터 판본 없음 |
| 목표 안 인도 | 강제 종결 뒤 이행 | A: 권리 확정 뒤 실제 인도, B: 조건부 보관 뒤 인도 | 권리와 물리 인도 분리 | 수량·시점 미승인 |
| 판본 이전 | 옛 저장 불러오기 | A: 명시적 판본 이전 계약, B: 비호환 저장 거절 유지 | 규칙 혼합 없는 복원 | 토큰 형식·이전 절차 없음 |
| 오류 모음 상한 | 저장 오류 표시 | A: 최대 개수와 잘림 표시, B: 안전 한도까지 수집 | 결정적이고 읽을 수 있는 진단 | 상한 미승인 |
| 난수 수치 계약 | 재현·저장 | A: 승인 해시·시드·추출 규격, B: 의존 기능 잠금 | 주소별 재현과 독립 스트림 | 알고리즘 미승인 |
| 시간 인코딩 | 틱·잔여·만기 | A: 고정 정수 단위와 유리수 잔여, B: 콘텐츠별 단위 등록 | 반올림 없는 재현 | 틱 크기·잔여 형식·생산자 없음 |

Basic 원문에 의존하는 계산은 필요한 인증 판본과 원문 입력이 현재 확인되지 않아 미결이다. 이것은 플레이 규칙의 선택지가 아니며, 기존 조사가 없었다는 뜻도 아니다.

CK3 비교 자료는 1.20.0.3, 빌드 25652598의 개발자 정의·호출 지점 기록 범위에서 확인되었다. 국소 콜백의 포로 석방 후 전쟁 종료 순서나 휴전 계산은 확인되지만 보편 사건 우선순위와 저장 복원 전체를 증명하지 않는다. Norland 비교 자료는 인용별 위키 oldid, MAIN/BETA 패치와 게시 시점 범위에서만 확인되었다. 같은 시각의 보편 순서가 아니라 대상별 선후와 패치별 저장·불러오기 수정이며, D18 전체를 대표하는 단일 설치 판본이나 네이티브 동작은 확인되지 않았다. 설치 빌드와 보존 문서의 대응도 미확인이다. 두 게임의 시간, 주기, 점수, 휴전, 사망 수치는 비교 자료일 뿐 서울의 계수가 아니다. 두 조사 모두 보편 사건 우선순위, 범용 결과 ID 원장, 범용 저장 계약을 입증하지 않았으므로 미결을 외부 게임 숫자로 채우지 않는다.

title: Guide to Characters and the 18 Design Domains
body_md:
# Guide to Characters and the 18 Design Domains

Status: Proposed. This distinguishes approved rules, selected policies, unadopted alternatives, and undecided values. It does not mean implementation is complete.

## Reading Order

- [Past/original-work reference sheet fields](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/): Distinguishes identity, abilities, health, language, functions, items, and scores in the original-work comparison. The current character follows the reader's 8 competencies, action proficiency, traits, and the six-body-part health contract.
- [Calculations and cases](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/): Distinguishes original-work reference formulas, the Seoul approval boundary, optional policies, and undecided inputs.
- [State cases](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/): Preserves the same identity, ownership, authority, and already completed effects.
- [Per-domain record fields](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/): Normalized data types are proposals and do not create domain-approved numeric values.
- [18 Actors, Inputs, Decisions, and Before/After Situations](/gdd/system-design/domain-situations/): Read the facts to preserve on failure and the actual sources.

## Original Rules for the 18 Domains

The rules and rejected alternatives for each domain can be read on the design pages below.

- [D01 Characters, Abilities, Traits, and Sheets](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d01/) · [Situations](/gdd/system-design/domain-situations/). Calculation links: REF-BL, REF-INTRO-3D, REF-ROUND-COST.
- [D02 Life, Needs, Health, and Mood](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d02/) · [Situations](/gdd/system-design/domain-situations/). Calculation links: consumes state contracts only.
- [D03 Actions, Orders, Authority, and Schedules](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d03/) · [Situations](/gdd/system-design/domain-situations/). Calculation links: SEOUL-RESERVATION.
- [D04 Labor, Population, Employment, and Rations](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d04/) · [Situations](/gdd/system-design/domain-situations/). Calculation links: SEOUL-POPULATION, SEOUL-RESERVATION.
- [D05 Economy, Production, Construction, and Resources](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d05/) · [Situations](/gdd/system-design/domain-situations/). Calculation links: SEOUL-CUTOFF, SEOUL-RESERVATION.
- [D06 Movement, Cargo, Maps, and Observation](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d06/) · [Situations](/gdd/system-design/domain-situations/). Calculation links: REF-BL, REF-ENCUMBRANCE, SEOUL-CARGO-CONSERVATION, SEOUL-CUTOFF, SEOUL-CARGO-RECEIPT-GUARDS.
- [D07 Relationships, Memory, Loyalty, and Evaluation](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d07/) · [Situations](/gdd/system-design/domain-situations/). Calculation links: SEOUL-RELATION-CLASS, SEOUL-SINGLE-RESULT.
- [D08 Houses, Kin, Marriage, and Adoption](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d08/) · [Situations](/gdd/system-design/domain-situations/). Calculation links: consumes state contracts only.
- [D09 Factions, Government, Institutions, and Legitimacy](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d09/) · [Situations](/gdd/system-design/domain-situations/). Calculation links: consumes state contracts only.

The situations for each domain can be read in [Domain Situations and Cases](/gdd/system-design/domain-situations/).

[Design Home](/gdd/design/home/) · [Mechanism Reference Index](/gdd/references/ref-mechanism-index/). The supported publishing surface for GDD design documents is /design-store/. Browse each document and domain through the design table of contents.

title: Original TRPG Core Rule System
body_md:
# Original TRPG Core Rule System

*Seoul: Nationwide* designs its own character system without operationally borrowing from external rule tables. The owner's decision of 2026-10-12 sets the eight competencies (Leadership, Strategy, Negotiation, Administration, Insight, Learning, Skill, and Stamina) at a base integer of 0–20, a final integer of 0–100, and a separate action proficiency of 0–99.9. A base competency of 10 means an expert in that field, and no effect can push the final value above 100. The single-Skill 0–12 resolution profile of 2026-10-08 is preserved as a past design and is not automatically applied to the new character system. The new resolution formula, effect composition, and growth formula are undecided.

## Past Opposed d10 Resolution Profile

The 2026-10-08 profile used a fair d10 for each of the acting side and the resisting side to calculate margin = (rA − rB) + (aA − aB) + c. Positive, zero, and negative results were classified as success, deadlock, and resisting-side success. The distributions of 45·10·45 for equal conditions and 64·8·28 for a 2-point Skill advantage were confirmed by full enumeration at the time. This verification is limited to the old profile and does not prove the resolution formula or probabilities of the new eight-competency and proficiency system.

The Skill 0–12 and the modifier −4 to +4 of the past profile seoul-opposed-d10-0-12-c4-v1 are records of that edition. They are neither converted to the new base competency 0–20, final 0–100, and proficiency 0–99.9, nor simply expanded in range. Resolution does not automatically generate facts of consent, ownership, arrival, treatment, or death; authority and actual fulfillment follow separate contracts.

## Preservation of Existing Figures

The 54,467 character figures of the existing 1,022 characters have been sealed without change. Ability scores, skills, CP, and auxiliary figures are preserved read-only as historical setting values and are not automatically converted into the new Skill. Both historical editions (parent pin ce173686, working copy 5f34d92d) are maintained, and issuance, screens, and APIs require an explicit edition selection. There is no automatic latest selection.

## Traits, Abilities, and Icons

Traits affect performance, action choices, stress, and relationships, and are acquired through events and actions. Core dispositions do not change easily, but some traits and states change through experience. The trait list and numerical effects will be designed separately, and the past nine logic and eight perspective categories are not automatically adopted. Authority is not granted by ability scores. Icons are produced in Seoul's own grammar, and traits for which there is no observation authority are not displayed.

## Calculation Sheets and Contracts

The past preserved ledger, edition selection, opposed d10, and eighteen-domain sheets are records verified by spreadsheet recalculation at the time. The existing modules in TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg are also contracts of that edition and do not mean the new system has been implemented.

The assignment of eight competencies, proficiencies, and traits to individual characters, the formulas for physiology, damage, growth, and effects, and the faction systems (city by city in the Free Cities) are subject to separate authoring. The degree of damage and functional state of both arms, both legs, head, and torso are distinguished from disease progression. This document records the confirmed scope and unresolved rules, not issuance to all characters or completed implementation.

# 독자 TRPG 핵심 규칙 체계

《서울:전국》은 외부 규칙표의 작동 차용 없이 자체 인물 체계를 설계한다. 2026-10-12 소유자 결정은 통솔·전략·교섭·운영·통찰·학습·기량·체력의 기본 정수 0–20, 최종 정수 0–100, 별도 행동 숙련 0–99.9를 정한다. 기본 역량 10은 해당 분야 숙련자이며 최종값은 어떤 효과로도 100을 넘지 않는다. 2026-10-08의 단일 기량 0–12 판정 프로필은 과거 설계로 보존하고 새 인물 체계에 자동 적용하지 않는다. 새 판정식·효과 합성·성장 산식은 미확정이다.

## 과거 대항 d10 판정 프로필

2026-10-08 프로필은 행위측과 저항측의 공정한 d10으로 마진=(rA−rB)+(aA−aB)+c를 계산했다. 양수·0·음수를 성과·교착·저항측 성과로 분류했으며 동등 조건의 45·10·45와 기량 2점 우위의 64·8·28 분포를 당시 전수 열거로 확인했다. 이 검증은 옛 프로필에 한정되며 새 8역량·숙련 체계의 판정식이나 확률을 증명하지 않는다.

과거 프로필 seoul-opposed-d10-0-12-c4-v1의 기량 0–12와 보정 −4–+4는 해당 판본의 기록이다. 이를 새 기본 역량 0–20·최종 0–100·숙련 0–99.9에 환산하거나 범위만 확대하지 않는다. 판정은 동의·소유권·도착·치료·사망의 사실을 자동 생성하지 않으며 권한과 실제 이행은 별도 계약을 따른다.

## 기존 수치 보존

기존 1,022명의 인물 수치 54,467개는 변경 없이 봉인했다. 능력치·기술·CP·보조 수치는 역사적 설정값으로 읽기 전용 보존하며 새 기량으로 자동 환산하지 않는다. 두 역사 판본(부모 핀 ce173686, 작업본 5f34d92d)을 모두 유지하고 발급·화면·API는 명시적 판본 선택을 요구한다. 자동 최신 선택은 없다.

## 특성·능력·아이콘

특성은 수행·행동 선택·스트레스·관계에 영향을 주고 사건과 행동으로 획득한다. 핵심 성향은 쉽게 변하지 않지만 경험으로 일부 특성과 상태가 변한다. 특성 목록과 수치 효과는 별도 설계하며 과거 아홉 논리·여덟 시각 범주를 자동 채택하지 않는다. 권한은 능력치가 부여하지 않는다. 아이콘은 서울 자체 문법으로 제작하고 관측 권한이 없는 특성은 표시하지 않는다.

## 계산 시트와 계약

과거 보존 원장·판본 선택·대항 d10·열여덟 영역 시트는 당시 스프레드시트 재계산으로 검증한 기록이다. TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg의 기존 모듈도 그 판본의 계약이며 새 체계 구현 완료를 뜻하지 않는다.

개별 인물의 8역량·숙련·특성 배정, 생리·피해·성장·효과 산식과 세력별 제도(자유도시들은 도시마다)는 별도 저작 대상이다. 양팔·양다리·머리·몸통의 손상 정도와 기능 상태, 질병 진행은 구분한다. 이 문서는 전원 발급이나 구현 완료가 아니라 확정된 범위와 미결 규칙을 기록한다.

title: Seoul: Nationwide Single-Player Detailed Design Document
body_md:
# Seoul: Nationwide Single-Player Detailed Design Document

Edition: SP-1.0.0 · 2026-10-03 · Canonical baseline GDD main eae8951b

This design document defines a campaign that one player continues through one main-body character. Other characters in the world are NPCs that use the same action contract. Here, a game session is a single campaign continued through saving and loading. Network connections, hosts, occupancy between players, and synchronization are not included in the design scope.

The confirmed rules of the existing GDD are maintained. Following the owner's instructions, the mechanisms of state, action, succession, transmission, relationships, saving, combat orders, justification, and original reinforcement are defined as contracts of this edition. Separate figures, empty faction data, and calculation coefficients are undecided. Calculation functions, new costs, and new durations are not invented as numbers. If there is no input in the system ledger, the relevant action is marked "System Undecided" and is not given arbitrary success or free processing.

## 1. The Center of Play and the Common Execution Contract

The player's goal is to maintain and expand the main-body character's survival, livelihood, relationships, skills, and rights. Becoming a head is not the only path of progression. Workers, agents, officers on duty, commanders, title holders, and institutional heads all act on the basis of their own qualifications and contracts. Livelihood achievements become evidence of contract fulfillment, and that evidence affects cooperation, appointment, support, and confirmation. Successfully completing a repair does not automatically grant a post.

### 1.1 Status Is Not Merged into a Single Rank Slot

| State Axis | Facts to Store | Meaning Read from Actions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Character | Permanent ID, survival, consciousness/injury, detention, ability to express intent | Can the character perform actions on their own |
| Location | Actual whereabouts, movement route, posture, progress | On-site access, interviews, work, combat participation |
| Affiliation and citizenship | Joining a faction, city, or organization (in the Government, entry in the register), recognizing party and edition | Rights and duties of the joined party |
| Office | Institution, title, tier, term/succession method, jurisdiction, signing authority | Which institutional acts can be approved |
| Title and Holding | Peerage ID, holder, target domain, superior contract, recognition status | What rights and duties the character holds |
| Effective control | On-site controller, stationing, occupation, dispute | Can it currently be enforced on site |
| Command | Target unit, command trunk line, scope of delegation, expiration | Which orders can be given to whom |
| Skill and Labor | Personal proficiency, qualifications, schedule, reservations | Can the character actually do the work |
| Property and access | Ownership, custody, use, collateral, lease, and vault authority | Can the character spend, transfer, or deliver the property |
| Relationships and memory | Directional trust, kinship, marriage, debt, oaths, event memories | Basis for acceptance, refusal, support, retaliation |

Post tier is a comparative classification. Even at Tier 1, the post differs by faction: the President for Life in the Government, a different holder in each city of the Free Cities (the Duke of Gwanak, the Ferry Keeper and others), and the Hierophant in the Arc (01-core section 8). Peerage and post, and occupation and command authority, are separate. Holding public office does not turn an institutional vault into personal property or give command over all troops.

### 1.2 Execution Order of All Actions

Common states: Proposal → Qualification check → Delivery/Receipt → Counterparty acceptance or institutional approval → Resource and schedule reservation → Execution → Result application → Receipt. The branch states are refusal, hold, cancellation, suspension, and expiration.

The inputs are the actor, target, action type, basis of authority, target ledger edition, location/contact route, conditions, resources, and cause event ID. The check order is target existence and edition → feasibility such as survival/detention → authority → actual location/delivery → resources and exclusive reservations → counterparty intent/institutional procedure. High trust does not make a physically impossible action succeed.

If death, dismissal, occupation, or loss of contact occurs between approval and execution, the reserved work is checked again. Supplies already consumed and progress already completed are not reversed, and only the remaining resources are released according to the contract. Resending the same event ID does not create a new result. Simultaneous transfers of rights are evaluated on the same ledger edition, and conflicts are resolved by a deterministic acceptance order.

The action UI distinguishes "Possible," "Prerequisites Lacking," "No Authority," "Awaiting Response," and "System Undecided" and displays the basis. It does not leak hidden facts through the reason display and instead explains with "Insufficient confirmed basis."

## 2. Actual Actions by Character and Peerage State

### 2.1 Common Actions and Restrictions

Every able person can perform their own movement, observation, conversation requests, personal purchase/transfer requests, job applications, education requests, treatment requests, and relationship actions. Location, passage rights, skills, resources, and the other party's consent are checked separately. A detained person can only hold the interviews, letters, and negotiations that the detention contract permits, and cannot move freely or do fieldwork. Injury does not act as a single entry on a prohibition list; it changes the conditions for performing the relevant action.

| Status/Rights State | Available Actions | Actions Requiring Additional Authority |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Unaffiliated·Random | Employment applications, trade, expeditions, escort contracts, membership requests, requests for arbitration of one's own rights | Joining before receiving a faction grant of a title domain, commanding faction troops, granting titles to others |
| Faction Member·No Office | Services under civic/organizational institutions, labor/education/service contracts, petitions for grants | Declaring war in the faction's name, disposing of public assets, ratifying records |
| Tier 5 Staff | Assigned counter, duty, and signing work; submitting evidence and reporting | Appointments, grants, or musters beyond one's own signing scope; a position without land is not treated as a title domain such as a station or dong |
| Tier 4~2 Institutional Officials | Orders, budgets, and duty assignments for delegated facilities, living areas, and tasks | Tier alone does not open up military command, inheritance, or full faction diplomacy |
| Title Holder | Contractual operations, income, and duties of one's own title; claims to restore rights; permitted sub-grants | Immediate use of facilities not yet occupied; arbitrary creation of titles of equal or higher rank |
| Appointed Commander | Posture, movement, and operation orders for the designated unit; remote orders are subject to the communication contract | Disposing of institution-owned property, forcing civilian labor, incorporating other units |
| Head of a Faction or City | Appointments, grant proposals, diplomacy, war approval, and succession procedures under its institutions | Another faction's ratification authority, granting titles higher than one's own, unconditional revocation without a contract violation |
| Claimant / Succession Candidate | Submitting evidence, asserting succession eligibility, requesting support, being a candidate beneficiary of a designated casus belli | Using a claim as ownership or on-site control |
| Occupier / Disputed Holder | Guarding, supplying, and negotiating under actual control; enforcing occupation rules | Occupation alone does not secure legitimate inheritance, ownership of institutional vaults, or residents' cooperation |

Each action is checked across multiple status axes. For example, a person holding a station or dong without command authority can make a "troop muster request" but cannot move another commander's unit by their own order. A records officer carries out claim-building work under a qualified head's order but does not personally gain anyone else's territory.

### 2.2 Actual Action Menu

- Daily Life: Apply for rations, buy water/food, request lodging/treatment, rest, attend appointments. Entitlement, actual supplies, and schedule are checked.
- Economy: Propose orders, reserve labor, approve repair/construction stages, commission escorts, deliver cargo, set up leases/collateral. The budget owner and the signer are distinguished.
- Politics: Join, support/recommend appointments, petition for title grants, propose contract amendments, apply for ratification, submit grounds for supporting/disqualifying a successor, negotiate marriage/adoption.
- Military: Authorized recruitment, assignment, and reorganization; movement/garrisoning/ambush; submitting war plans; declaring war; attacking objectives; requesting withdrawal/surrender. Actual command authority is distinguished from access to the mobilization roster.
- Intelligence: Scouting, receiving reports, requesting record access, refuting/exposing rumors, creating authorized records. Known facts are distinguished from the authority to disclose them.

## 3. Starting, Conducting, and Ending a War

### 3.1 Casus Belli Contract Before Declaring War

War inputs are the war ID, approver and authority, attack/defense leads, casus belli ID, target title/territory, beneficiary, demands, approval cost, objectives, and each ending effect. A "hostile relationship" alone does not open a declaration of war. A main character without office may make plans, give support, and propose beneficiaries, but cannot approve a faction war. A person who heads a faction or city uses that seat's head procedures.

Registered casus belli categories: restoring recognized rights, supporting an eligible third party's claim, and redress for breach of obligations under an approved superior contract. Whether each category is registered, its target scope, cost, truce, and reparations are pending confirmation. Personal debts, passage disputes, and water-supply cutoffs are not automatically converted into grounds for territorial conquest. An unregistered casus belli does not create a war.

### 3.2 War State Transitions

Preparation → validation → declaration record → in progress → peace request/demand fulfilled/surrender/casus belli void → ending effects applied → post-war contract. If preparation fails, no war is created. During the war, battle, occupation, and prisoner events reference the relevant war and objective, and each event changes the score only once.

The existing confirmed score is an attack/defense value of -100 to +100 in opposite directions, and it changes through battles, occupation, key prisoners, and objective control. Battle score between heads is capped at 50, capturing the head gives +100, capturing the designated first/second/third successor gives +50/+25/+10, and occupying the capital gives +10. These are used only when they correspond to an actual institutional head, successor, or capital. Candidates for a seat filled by acclamation or name-worth are not arbitrarily designated "first successor" to award points. The duration of objective occupation and the rate of increase are undecided.

+30 qualifies one to request a white peace, but acceptance is not guaranteed. +100 enforces the demands fixed in the casus belli, -100 is surrender by the losing side, and voluntary surrender is also possible. Separately from the score, if the grounds for the casus belli disappear, the void rules for that casus belli are checked. The death of a head alone does not automatically end every war.

### 3.3 Separating Military Actions from War

Viewing the mobilization roster or armory is not unit creation. Actual formations are created only after personnel acceptance, equipment, supplies, commander, and reservation checks. Automatic battles are decided by the local commander based on objective, posture, observation, and authority, and use the same adjudication/result ledger as manual ones. Only battles the main character actually joined provide the field screen. Late joiners must satisfy the permitted reinforcement conditions, entry route, and actual arrival.

Winning a battle is not the same as winning the war. Occupying a stronghold changes on-site control, but facility recovery, residents' cooperation, and the transfer of legal rights are separate. Occupation outside the objectives does not widen the scope of demands. Withdrawal requires a valid retreat route and is recorded differently from a rout, an accepted surrender, or capture.

### 3.4 Order of Ending Procedures

Lock ending inputs → recheck casus belli and beneficiary → finalize the rights transfer list → occupation retain/return list → prisoner handling → reparations/truce/superior contract → cancel or recheck ongoing orders → event receipt. If two different wars try to transfer the same title at once, a ledger version conflict occurs and the second settlement is reviewed again. If a battle opens during a peace proposal, it is rechecked against the facts at the time of acceptance.

Example: If A fights to restore B's claim and wins, B becomes the new holder of the target right. A does not get all the occupied lands. The superior relationship between B and A is checked against the conditions stated in the casus belli, and actual control of the water intake and the cooperation of the station office remain separate matters.

## 4. Granting, Delegating, and Revoking Titles

### 4.1 Grant Contract

Inputs: grantor, recipient, faction membership status, target title and version, grant authority, superior contract, rights·duties·term, ratifying body, and delivery conditions for relics/documents/keys. To receive a grant from an existing faction, one must already belong to it. A head may only distribute titles lower than their own, and the existing rule limiting direct holding to two duchies (districts) is maintained. At the 2126 opening each of the 25 duchies has one holder (Bible 2.4). No arbitrary title is created where there is no actual title ID, territory, or rank.

States: draft → authority/target check → recipient consent → ratification/approval → rights ledger change → operational takeover → completed or disputed. The default policy is not to change the holder before the required ratification. If on-site takeover fails after approval, it remains as "rights held·not recovered/takeover incomplete." In the Government, omitting the register entry or the district office's seal check is grounds for invalidity (provisional T21-sysdesign-4-2).

When a right changes hands, the target right is removed from the grantor's holdings list and the same title ID is registered to the recipient. For subordinate contracts and tax/water-supply/passage and ritual duties, the signer and succession policy are recorded. Buildings, institutional vaults, public stockpiles, and unit command are not transferred automatically unless each one's inclusion is explicitly stated.

### 4.2 Distinguish Appointment, Grant, and Delegation

Appointment gives official authority. Grant changes the holder of a title right. Delegation leaves the original holder in place and entrusts only specified operations/signing/command. Delegation status is valid, suspended, expired, or revoked, and the basis event and scope are stored. If the proxy dies, the original holder's rights do not disappear.

A revocation proposal requires the contract's revocation clause, evidence of violation, and the ratification procedure. If a relic is reclaimed without withdrawing the delegation, a betrayal issue opens as under the existing rules. Others' personal property or positions are not immediately removed just because of a higher tier. Illegal seizure is not marked as a normal grant, and is recorded as a change in on-site control and a rights dispute.

Validation cases: rejection of an unaffiliated recipient; version conflict when the same title is granted to two people simultaneously; original holder retained when ratification is refused; takeover incomplete when the grant succeeds but the keys are not delivered; distinguishing drafts from confirmed rights before and after the grantor's death.

## 5. Succession and Title Transfer

### 5.1 Three Kinds of Succession

Player main-character succession, faction, city, or institution head succession, and succession to individual titles and property are handled as separate events. All of the dead main character's authority, skills, and friends are not copied to the person who becomes the new main character.

Previously confirmed: when the main body dies or is permanently detained, the designated successor becomes the new main body; if there is none, the person next in the line of succession does. If there is no successor, that character's path ends. The viewpoint moves to the new main body's actual location, and the remaining squad elects a temporary private-rank squad leader. Check the contract scope to confirm that command of the remaining unit passes validly to the new main body.

Even when the main body changes because of permanent detention, the detained person is still alive. Do not treat this as death or open an inheritance. The specific criteria for judging permanent detention and whether re-manipulation is allowed are pending confirmation.

### 5.2 Processing Order for Succession Events

Confirm the basis for death/vacancy → suspend the deceased's new personal actions, or, if a living person loses a post, suspend only the signing, command, and operating authority of the vacated post → snapshot the lists of posts, titles, property, and contracts → look up each item's succession system → check candidate eligibility → run procedures such as election/nomination/examination/hereditary succession → ratification → transfer rights item by item → handover/takeover → record disputes. The personal life and movement of a living person, and actions under a separate valid contract, are judged by their own eligibility conditions and are not suspended merely because a post is vacant. Post authority is distinguished from personal property, title rights, and other valid contracts, and a vacancy alone does not trigger automatic inheritance, transfer, appointment of a proxy, or absorption of authority. The claims of candidates who were not chosen remain according to the system; a person is not deleted for having been eliminated.

Even if a post is vacant after a leader's death, the institution and the faction do not automatically cease to exist. Only persons and scopes registered in the system are permitted to act as proxy. If there is no eligible person or procedure, it remains a vacancy/succession dispute, and no anonymous leader is automatically generated.

### 5.3 Basis of Each Faction's Leader Procedure and Remaining Inputs

In particular, what happens when the stamps of an acclamation never all come in, the scope of an acting Member and an acting President, and how the Hierophant after Go Ye-jin is chosen are open questions to be confirmed.

### 5.4 Inheritance of Claims and Rights

Title-holding rights follow the succession system of that title. Enforced claims keep the existing path by which they pass to eligible children as unenforced claims, and unenforced claims are not separately inherited. A spouse does not automatically share all claims merely by being a spouse. Public-office candidacy, voting rights, and technical qualifications are not handled as the same data type as title claims.

When the leader of an ongoing war dies, the new responsible party, beneficiary, and casus belli are rechecked. Whether personal promises and post promises are maintained, re-ratified, or terminated is judged item by item. Succession must not be used to erase debts, ceasefires, or damage records.

## 6. Ownership, Transfer, and Handover of Assets

### 6.1 Classifying Assets

Personally owned supplies, equipment, and currency; institution-owned warehouses/vaults/facilities; joint/share property; leases and usage permits; debts, claims, and collateral; and records, keys, and relics are all separate. A custodian is not an owner, and holding a key is not itself a legal right. People are not on the list of transferable assets. There are no thinking machines in Seoul, so worker machines and humanoids are assets as scarce equipment (v3 chapter 03 section 8).

Asset state has location, quantity/unit, owner, custodian, usage rights, reservations, collateral, in-transit status, and disputes. Logistics state and legal-rights state are kept separate. Cargo in transit during war also keeps the same asset ID/split origin.

### 6.2 Contract for Transfer upon Death

Personal property determines its beneficiary by checking the faction's system, any valid will, and marriage/joint-property contracts. Institutional property stays with the institution, and the new post holder takes over only the management authority they need. Usage rights and leases are maintained, re-approved, or terminated according to their succession clauses. Debts and claims are checked for whether they belong to the individual, the post, or the institution, and for succession clauses; debt is not unconditionally pushed onto every successor.

The order is: finalize the inheritance list → mark disputes/collateral → transfer ownership → reserve actual handover → verify receipt. Even after gaining ownership, supplies in an enemy-occupied warehouse do not teleport into the inventory. Divided inheritance preserves the total quantity, and supplies that are reserved or pledged as collateral are marked separately. An undetermined system means inheritance is put on hold; it is not replaced by an ownerless state or automatic equal distribution.

Example: when the bench master of a workbench house dies, personal equipment and personal shares are divided separately from the workshop's store. A child's inheritance of shares and the new bench master's authority to place store orders are different events. Even if personal equipment in transit is inherited, it cannot be used before the cargo arrives.

Permanent storage: previous owner, beneficiary, quantity, basis, collateral, reservation, handover location, fulfillment status, cause ID. Reapplying the same death event must not duplicate property. If a will change and a death occur at the same time, use the recognized event order and the institutionally valid time.

## 7. Transfer, Education, and Loss of Knowledge

### 7.1 Separating Records from People's Proficiency

A knowledge object has content/edition, source, authenticity/verification, confidentiality, and ownership/viewing rights. A person has the records they have encountered, understanding, practice progress, performed proficiency, and qualifications. Inheriting a document transfers ownership or viewing rights of the paper/medium; it is not a copy of proficiency. When a master dies, the disciple's existing proficiency remains, but the available teachers and verification routes for new education change.

### 7.2 Education State Contract

Education request → teacher/institution acceptance → check each skill's requirements → reserve schedule, tools, and location → instruction/reading/practice → assessment → record progress/proficiency. For each skill, author whether teacher, records, tools, practice location, and learner conditions are required. The same items are not enforced across all skills.

If a teacher dies, tools are damaged, someone is detained, or a location is lost, record the reason for suspending/holding the education and preserve the progress already gained. When transferring to another teacher, check the recognizable progress for that skill. If someone has read the records but cannot practice, only the record access/understanding state changes. Nominating an apprentice is a post-candidacy event and is separate from completing skill proficiency.

### 7.3 Disclosure, Exchange, and Concealment

Information transmission checks the sender's actual knowledge, disclosure authority, and the receiving route. When a report is delivered, the recipient gains knowledge with a source and a time of verification, not the entirety of the world's current facts. Forgery, exposure, and refutation leave competing evidence and events rather than erasing the original. When a secret is leaked, the exposed information and the person's responsibility are recorded separately.

Verification cases: no duplicate proficiency gains from inheriting the same document; learning progress is kept after a teacher's death; maintenance ability and manufacturing ability are separate; a successor without access rights does not automatically obtain institutional secrets; an old report does not guarantee the current location.

## 8. Changes in Character Relationships and Permanent Effects

### 8.1 The Roles of Values and Facts

The previously confirmed relationship value is directional trust T[A,B]. No separate affection value is added. The thresholds of T 25 or above for friend, -25 or below for enemy, and -50 or below for nemesis are kept. Family, marriage, romance, master/disciple, contracts, debts, oaths, and command are real relationship facts and are not the same as trust. Just because A trusts B does not mean B trusts A at the same value.

Loyalty to the leader one serves is a separate existing state from 0 to 100. It reads the daily mood and trust in the leader, and the leader themselves is at 100. If loyalty stays below 25, paths open for a successor's rebellion or the defection of other heroes, but the duration, amount of change, and risky-action thresholds are undecided. Do not interpret this as a rebellion that must occur every day.

### 8.2 Processing Relationship Events

Spending time together, treatment and rescue, fulfilling/violating contracts, gifts and trades, public support and insults, exposure, detention and release, and marriage, adoption, and death are the sources of relationship events. For each event, record the actor, target, harm/benefit, witness/report, secrecy scope, and basis. Modifier amounts use confirmed rules; if undecided, no arbitrary numbers are inserted.

The evaluating party updates its own trust and memory at the point when it learns of the event through observation or report. A method in which hidden betrayals are known instantly from anywhere in the world is not used. Direct harm is distinguished from public reputation, and no fixed personality or betrayal probability is assigned to a faction.

### 8.3 Actual Behavior Changed by Relationships

Relationships are inputs for judging whether to accept an interview, accept risky work, support a successor, accept a teacher, testify, and whom to protect, conceal, defect from, or plot against. High trust does not create command authority, property rights, consent, or passage rights that do not exist. Even when a relationship changes, existing contracts change through termination clauses and action events. When a friend becomes an enemy, all trades and unit organizations do not automatically vanish at that moment.

When someone dies, the survivors' family/romantic relationships and mourning events remain. The deceased's T[A,B] is not copied to the successor. The new main body starts with the personal relationships it already had, and the previous person's contracts, institutional obligations, and public history are each carried over by succession policy.

### 8.4 What Remains Permanently in the Campaign

Store title/post history, rights disputes, fulfillment/violation of promises, prisoners, injuries and deaths, marriage and kinship, education progress, disclosed evidence, property and debts, ceasefire and war outcomes, and witnessed events/memories along with current trust. Later actions reread these facts. Loading a save and changing the main body do not reset them.

Permanent storage does not mean every emotion is fixed forever. For effects with recovery, reconciliation, mourning, change, or expiry periods, the rule and the end point are stored together. The forgetting/decay function is pending confirmation. The world record of hidden facts and the facts each character knows are stored separately.

Example: If A breaches a escort contract with B, trust, memory, and the contract breach are recorded according to the grounds B learned of. Even if A's successor C becomes the Principal, B's personal trust in C is separate. If an office-attached reparation obligation has been inherited, it remains with C's institution, and personal promises are handled according to the maintain/re-ratify/terminate policy.

## 9. Single-Player Time, Saving, and Principal Succession

World time is singular. The player engages with the world through one Principal's actions and valid command authority. NPCs follow the same movement, labor, education, political, and combat conditions. Switching screens does not rewind time or duplicate the Principal to a remote location. As previously approved, combat has no pause, speed control, or command queue. This document does not add new campaign time controls.

Save boundary: A snapshot is made at a consistent simulation boundary where accepted events and result application are complete, and subsequent events are recorded after it. Quitting/loading is not an in-world death or departure event. Ongoing wars, orders, education, cargo, handovers, succession procedures, and reservations are restored from their current stage. An already applied ResultId is not applied again. A rules-version mismatch or corrupted save is an explicit error and is not silently replaced with a new campaign.

Principal succession performs the step of changing only the screen subject and the transfer of rights as separate steps. Even if a new Principal is selected at the moment of death, incomplete inheritance procedures, disputes, and handovers remain. Reports/records that become inaccessible because the Principal changed are displayed in a restricted way according to the new character's knowledge and qualifications.

## 10. Detail Screens the Player Checks

- Character: survival, injury, detention, and actual location; affiliation/position/title/command authority; schedule and reservations; skills; property; directional relationships; currently available actions and reasons for unavailability.
- Title: the four domains of holding, claim, effective control, and ratification; superior contract; method of conferral/succession; income/obligations; assets being handed over; change history.
- War: justification, objectives, beneficiaries, and termination effects; the event-by-event basis for the score; actual participation/supply/occupation; peace proposal status; prisoners; termination settlement.
- Succession: grounds for death/vacancy; differences between Principal candidates and candidates by position/title; qualifications, ratification procedure, and disputes; list of transmissions/handovers; contracts to maintain/re-ratify/terminate.
- Assets/Knowledge: who owns, stores, and uses them; reservations/collateral/access restrictions; current handover location; difference between records and mastery; education stage and reason for interruption.
- Relationships: distinction between character A→B and B→A; disclosable causal events; contract status; kinship/oath/command facts; recoverable effects and permanent history.

Each screen is a surface that reads ledger facts. Pressing a button sends a request to the common action contract, and unconfirmed actions are shown as pending. The report diagram does not replace this detailed design document.

Confirmed: cross-qualification checks, no rights change before ratification, item-by-item succession, institutional assets remaining in place, actual handover, separation of permanent detention from death, separation of records from mastery, preservation of education progress, relationship updates after observation, no copying of personal relationships to successors, and single-campaign saves.

Pending data: actual title decrees and holders, candidate/election/exam/ratification inputs by faction, costs/truces/reparations by justification list, adjudication functions and correction/decay coefficients, and price lists for individual negotiation items. Pending data is not automatically generated as approval of canonical mechanics.

## 12. State Verification Scenarios

Refusal of conferral to an unaffiliated character; head's death just before conferral approval; simultaneous conferral of the same title; successful rights inheritance with failed handover of a warehouse occupied by the enemy; no property inheritance after the Principal's permanent detention; different beneficiaries of a public-office election and personal property inheritance; valid/invalid branching of a war justification during a change of successor; non-attribution of occupation outside the objective; restoration of existing progress after a teacher's death; per-observer updates of a relationship secret; separation of contract succession from personal trust; rejection of re-settlement of the same ResultId after a save restore. In each case, compare the state before and after, the reason for failure, totals, IDs, and event order.
